qa.question: 《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》如何把图像转换为 Transformer 的输入？训练任务是什么？
qa.reference_answer: 先将图像分成 patch，对每个 patch 作线性嵌入，将这些嵌入组成序列输入 Transformer；图像 patch 被当作 NLP 中的 token 处理。模型以监督方式训练执行图像分类。

gold_evidence.evidence: To do so, we split an image into patches and provide the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Trans- former. Image patches are treated the same way as tokens (words) in an NLP application. We train the model on image classification in supervised fashion.

qa.reference_answer: 最大深度为152层；残差网络集成在ImageNet测试集上的错误率为3.57%。

gold_evidence.evidence: On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers—8 × deeper than VGG nets [40] but still having lower complex- ity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set.

qa.question: 请总结论文《Multi-View Semantic–Geometric Perception for Post-Disaster Flexible Suction with Metric 3D Scene Reconstruction》的输入、三个处理模块和输出。
qa.reference_answer: 输入为机械臂相机采集的同步多视角RGB图像。三个模块为轻量障碍物实例分割、具有物理尺度的3D场景重建、带约束的吸取点选择。YOLO-LiteSeg生成语义实例掩码，VGGT预测相机参数与深度并重建场景，之后进行尺度对齐，将2D障碍物标签投影到3D点云。输出为满足预设吸取深度与最大化最小障碍物间距准则的吸取点参考；该参考不等于完整吸取轨迹或过程的全局最优方案。

scene reconstruction, and constraint-based suction-point selection.

YOLO-LiteSeg gener-

Finally, semantic labels from

and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.

yielding a selected suction-point reference rather than a

qa.question: 请总结论文《An Intelligent Framework for Tooth Segmentation and Classification Through Fusion of Transfer Learning with Advanced Optimization Algorithms Using Biomedical Images》的主要处理链与评测对象。
qa.reference_answer: TSCFFM-AOABI先用Blur、MedianBlur、ToGray和CLAHE增强图像，再用Adam训练的YOLO11s分割牙齿实例。DenseNet201、MobileNet和ShuffleNetV2提取分割区域的互补特征并融合，由KELM分类，BCO优化KELM惩罚参数C和RBF核参数γ。论文使用包含598张牙科X光图像与32类牙齿的基准集，报告准确率96.17%、精确率95.10%、召回率99.03%和F1 98.00%；这些是该数据集实验报告，不能直接等同于临床部署效果。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Methods: The proposed frame work first 
applies image augmentation using Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and Contrast -Limited 
Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to improve image variability and feature vis-
ibility. Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer.

The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

Results: The proposed framework is evaluated on a benchmark dental X-ray image 
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes. Experimental results demonstrate an 
accuracy of 96.17%, precision of 95.10%, recall of 99.03%, and an F1-score of 98.00%.

qa.question: 结合论文《Vision-Guided Cone Manipulation with Collaborative Robotic Arm》和《Occlusion-Aware Watermelon Size Estimation Using YOLO11-OBB and Amodal GAN》，归纳两项工作如何把视觉感知结果转化为下游任务所需的信息。

qa.question: 根据《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》，为什么不能仅根据ImageNet上从头训练的表现否定ViT？请结合归纳偏置和预训练规模的实验讨论。
qa.reference_answer: ViT缺少CNN的局部性和平移等变性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化会受到影响；这说明小数据训练结果依赖数据规模，不能直接否定该架构。论文在更大预训练集上看到更强结果：ViT-Large在ImageNet预训练下不如ViT-Base，ImageNet-21k下相近，JFT-300M下才显现大模型的完整收益。该结论限定于论文的模型与实验，不能推成任意数据规模下ViT都优于CNN。

gold_evidence.evidence:

However, the picture changes if the models are trained on larger datasets (14M-300M images). We

When pre-trained on the

qa.question: 论文《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》为什么同时引入双向SSM和位置嵌入？它们分别处理什么问题？
qa.reference_answer: 论文将原始Mamba用于视觉的困难概括为单向建模和缺乏位置感知。双向SSM用于依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模；位置嵌入为视觉识别提供位置信息，在密集预测中体现空间感知。它们是不同问题的对应设计，不能把双向性理解为代替位置信息。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

Furthermore, the position embedding in Vim
block provides the awareness for spatial information, which
enables Vim to be more robust in dense prediction tasks.

qa.question: 根据《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》，为什么线性探测更省训练资源却仍不被推荐作为端到端微调的替代评测？
qa.reference_answer: 冻结编码器会改变不同VFM的表现与排名，论文得到的排名相关系数仅0.38。因此线性探测虽然减少训练成本，却不足以代表端到端微调的结果；作者建议使用端到端微调来获得有代表性的比较。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Current VFMs
may not acquire enough spatial semantic understanding in
pretraining to perform semantic segmentation effectively
without end-to-end fine-tuning. Furthermore, a low correla-
tion coefficient of 0.38 suggests freezing the encoder signif-
icantly changes the performance ranking. Therefore, even
though linear probing is efficient, end-to-end fine-tuning is
recommended for a representative benchmark.

qa.question: 根据《SBRF-Det: Scale-Boundary Representative Fusion for Multi-Finding Detection in Panoramic Dental Radiographs》，为什么边界相关局部信息对mAP50-95比仅正确分类更关键？请结合正文中的局部与全局融合解释。
qa.reference_answer: mAP50-95要求在逐渐严格的IoU阈值下仍有准确边界框重叠，正确类别本身不足以获得较高指标。局部信息保留病灶边缘、修复体界面、牙根等结构线索，可以影响框几何；全局上下文帮助区分外观相似而解剖位置不同的发现。边界门控对局部分支增强调节更强、对全局分支仅适度衰减，以兼顾边界定位与语义上下文。

gold_evidence.evidence:
A strong boundary response increases
the local contribution while only moderately attenuating the global branch.

Global context
helps distinguish visually similar structures that occur in different anatomical settings,
while local evidence is retained around lesion margins, restoration interfaces, root struc-
tures, and other high-frequency regions. The P4 placement further preserves a spatial
resolution at which these cues can influence box geometry. This design is particularly
relevant to mAP50-95, where correct class prediction alone is insufficient and bounding-box
overlap must remain accurate across progressively stricter IoU thresholds.

qa.question: 根据《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》，为什么可见光与红外需要互补融合，而简单平均仍有局限？
qa.reference_answer: 可见光提供轮廓、纹理与结构异常，但受光照、背景和遮挡影响；红外能揭示异常发热，却缺少丰富纹理且结构边界模糊。简单平均能加入两种信息，但平等对待所有模态和位置，不考虑模态特性、空间重要性与热响应分布。论文因此采用热感知门控和共享/专属特征交互；在该文同协议检测对比中，提出方法的mAP@0.5:0.95为0.657，简单平均为0.597，不能把该结果外推到所有融合任务。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Visible images provide rich appear-
ance, contour, and texture information and are therefore suitable for identifying structural
abnormalities such as damage, cracks, deformation, and foreign object attachment. Infrared
images provide complementary thermal response information and are particularly use-
ful for revealing abnormal heating associated with poor contact, insulation degradation,
and other thermally related faults. However, visible images are sensitive to illumination,
background interference, and occlusion, whereas infrared images generally provide limited
texture details and relatively blurred structural boundaries [4].

However, simple averaging treats visible and infrared information equally and does
not consider modality-specific characteristics, spatial importance, or thermal response
distribution. The proposed fused representation achieves precision, recall, and mAP at
IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936, 0.921, and 0.943, respectively. Compared with simple average
fusion, the proposed framework improves mAP at IoU = 0.5:0.95 from 0.597 to 0.657,
corresponding to an absolute improvement of 0.060.

qa.question: 论文《Constructing a Xiangyunsha Defect Dataset and a Lightweight Detection Model for Sustainability》为什么把测试集排除在模型选择之外，并在修订划分后从头训练模型？
qa.reference_answer: 测试集只在最终结构选择后用于最终评估，训练集用于优化，验证集用于模型规模比较、消融和选择，从而避免把模型开发用过的数据当作独立最终评测。修订协议下从头训练且不继承旧实验的权重、检查点、优化器状态或其他学习状态，避免旧实验状态影响新划分。作者明确说该协议分离开发与保留集评估，并降低把验证表现报告成最终模型表现的评价偏差。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The training set was used for model optimization, while the validation set was used for
model‑scale comparison, architectural ablation, and final model selection. The 100‑image
held‑out test set was excluded from all model‑development decisions and was used only
after the final architecture had been selected. All models reported under this revised
protocol were trained from scratch using the revised data partition, without inheriting
checkpoints, model weights, optimizer states, or other learned states from the experiments
reported in the original submission.

This revised protocol separates model development from final held‑out evaluation and
reduces the evaluation bias associated with reporting validation‑set performance as final
model performance.

qa.question: 论文《Zero-Shot Water Monitoring from Fixed Drainage Surveillance Imagery Across Day/Night and Rain/No-Rain Conditions: A SAM 3 Benchmark at 25 Urban Sites》为什么不把复合报警规则在102个负例帧上的0误报直接称为已验证误报率？它如何进一步评估？

qa.question: 根据《Multi-View Semantic–Geometric Perception for Post-Disaster Flexible Suction with Metric 3D Scene Reconstruction》，为什么仅有2D实例掩码或未对齐物理尺度的3D重建不足以支持吸取点选择？
qa.reference_answer: 2D掩码提供障碍物语义，但不能直接给出物理高度、坡度或障碍物间距。吸取深度、沉积厚度、距离等是有单位的量，未定尺度的重建不能直接应用这些约束。论文将YOLO-LiteSeg语义与VGGT几何结合，用棋盘格对齐到物理尺度并将2D标签转到3D点云，在吸取深度和最大化最小障碍物间距准则下生成参考点。

out semantics cannot distinguish obstacle regions from obstacle-free sludge regions.

For ﬂexible suction, the reconstructed geometry must addi-
tionally be converted to physical scale because sludge-deposit thickness, height proﬁles, 
obstacle distances, and suction depth are metric quantities rather than scale-ambiguous 
geometric descriptors.

Finally, semantic labels from 
the  2D  obstacle  instance  masks  are  transferred  to  the  corresponding  reconstructed  3D 
points,  and  the  resulting metric  3D  scene  representation  integrating  obstacle  semantics 
and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.

qa.question: 论文《Occlusion-Aware Watermelon Size Estimation Using YOLO11-OBB and Amodal GAN》为什么需要非模态分割与椭圆先验，而不只使用可见区域分割？

gold_evidence.evidence: To do so, we split an image into patches and provide the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Trans- former. Image patches are treated the same way as tokens (words) in an NLP application. We train the model on image classification in supervised fashion.

agent.question: 《Attention Is All You Need》3.1 节描述的编码器、解码器分别堆叠几层？各子层及嵌入层输出维度是多少？
agent.reference_answer: 编码器和解码器均为N=6层；各子层和嵌入层的输出维度d_model=512。

gold_evidence.evidence: Encoder: The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers.
all sub-layers in the model, as well as the embedding layers, produce outputs of dimension dmodel = 512.
Decoder: The decoder is also composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers.

agent.answer:
在《Attention Is All You Need》中，编码器和解码器的具体结构如下：

- 编码器：每个编码器层有两个子层。第一个子层是一个多头自注意力机制，第二个子层是一个全连接的前馈网络。
- 解码器：除了两个子层外，还添加了一个第三个子层：一个多头自注意力机制。

此外，编码器和解码器都包含残差连接、层归一化和dropout。

总结：编码器和解码器的具体层数及各子层输出维度的详细描述在《Attention Is All You Need》中没有明确给出，但可以确定的是，编码器和解码器都包含多头自注意力机制和全连接的前馈网络。

## Paper Comparison

### 1. Method
**Attention Is All You Need (Paper A):**
- The core method involves the use of the Transformer model, which relies on multi-headed self-attention mechanisms.
- It replaces traditional recurrent layers with attention mechanisms, focusing on parallel processing capabilities.

**An Image is Worth 16x16 Words (Paper B):**
- The method involves applying a standard Transformer directly to images.
- It splits images into patches and provides the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as input to the Transformer.
- The model is pre-trained on large-scale datasets like ImageNet-21k and JFT-300M, without introducing specific inductive biases for image recognition.

### 2. Dataset / Task
**Attention Is All You Need (Paper A):**
- Tasks: Machine translation.
- Datasets: WMT 2014 English-German dataset, WMT 2014 English-French dataset.

**An Image is Worth 16x16 Words (Paper B):**
- Tasks: Image classification.
- Datasets: ImageNet-21k, JFT-300M, CIFAR-100, VTAB suite of 19 tasks.

### 3. Experimental Results
**Attention Is All You Need (Paper A):**
- The Transformer outperforms RNN sequence-to-sequence models and the Berkeley Parser when trained on a smaller dataset (40K sentences).

**An Image is Worth 16x16 Words (Paper B):**
- The model achieves high accuracy on various benchmarks, including 88.55% on ImageNet, 90.72% on ImageNet-ReaL, 94.55% on CIFAR-100, and 77.63% on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.

### 4. Main Similarities
- Both papers leverage the Transformer architecture.
- Both demonstrate the effectiveness of the Transformer in achieving state-of-the-art performance on their respective tasks.

### 5. Main Differences
- **Method:** Paper A focuses on machine translation, while Paper B applies the Transformer to image recognition.
- **Datasets and Tasks:** Paper A uses translation datasets, whereas Paper B uses image recognition datasets.
- **Results:** Paper A reports performance on translation tasks, while Paper B reports results on various image recognition benchmarks.

### 6. Conclusion
Both papers highlight the versatility and effectiveness of the Transformer architecture. While Paper A demonstrates the model's capability in machine translation, Paper B showcases its performance in image recognition tasks. The key differences lie in the application domain and the specific datasets used, but both papers underscore the transformative impact of the Transformer on their respective fields.

Panoramic dental radiographs frequently contain multiple coexisting patho-
logical, anatomical, and treatment-related findings that vary in scale, contrast, and bound-
ary definition.

We propose
SBRF-Det, a one-stage multi-finding detector integrating scale-dependent representative al-
location with boundary-conditioned local–global feature fusion at P4/16.

Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer. The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes.

## Paper Comparison

### 1. Method
- **Paper A (SBRF-Det):** The method extends RP-P4 by incorporating a scale-dependent representative-count rule and a boundary-conditioned fusion of global representative context with local structural evidence. It retains representative interaction but introduces scale-dependent representative allocation, a local depth-wise structural pathway, and boundary-conditioned modulation.
- **Paper B:** The proposed framework integrates image augmentation, multi-scale supervision, and a fusion of feature extraction models and advanced optimization algorithms to address the challenges of tooth segmentation and classification in dental X-ray images.

### 2. Dataset / Task
- **Paper A:** The dataset used is "OralXrays-9," and the task is multi-finding detection in panoramic dental radiographs.
- **Paper B:** The dataset consists of 598 images across 32 tooth classes, and the tasks are tooth segmentation and classification.

### 3. Experimental Results
- **Paper A:** The results include precision, recall, and mAP50 and mAP50-95 values. SBRF-Det achieved 0.8777 precision, 0.8979 recall, 0.9152 mAP50, and 0.7029 mAP50-95. The mAP50-95 increased by 0.95 percentage points relative to the matched YOLO12l baseline.
- **Paper B:** The results include accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The accuracy was 96.17%, precision was 95.10%, recall was 99.03%, and the F1-score was 98.00%.

### 4. Main Similarities
- Both papers focus on improving the accuracy of tasks related to dental radiographs.
- Both methods incorporate advanced techniques to enhance the performance of their respective tasks.

### 5. Main Differences
- **Methodology:** Paper A uses a scale-boundary representative fusion approach, while Paper B integrates image augmentation, multi-scale supervision, and advanced optimization algorithms.
- **Dataset and Task Scope:** Paper A deals with multi-finding detection in panoramic dental radiographs, whereas Paper B focuses on tooth segmentation and classification across multiple tooth classes.
- **Performance Metrics:** Paper A reports precision, recall, and mAP values, while Paper B provides accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

### 6. Conclusion
Both papers aim to improve the accuracy of tasks related to dental radiographs but employ different methodologies and focus on distinct tasks. Paper A uses a scale-boundary representative fusion approach for multi-finding detection, while Paper B integrates advanced optimization and image processing techniques for tooth segmentation and classification. The results from both papers indicate significant improvements in their respective tasks, with Paper B achieving higher accuracy and F1-score.

The system operates within a ROS2-based frame-
work and utilizes object position data provided by a YOLO-based vision subsystem. To
improve localization accuracy, multiple measurements are collected and averaged before
grasp planning. The grasping sequence is executed through predefined observation poses,
including an initial detection position and a secondary pose above the target. When the
cone is detected outside the optimal observation region, an additional intermediate obser-
vation pose is generated to further reduce localization errors.

Grasp reliability is enhanced
through a weight-based validation method utilizing the collaborative robot’s built-in force
sensing capability. The measured load before and after grasping is compared, and unsuc-
cessful grasps automatically trigger up to three retry attempts.

stacle-highlighted metric 3D scene representation for constraint-based suction-point se-
lection.

ble spatial information for post-disaster ﬂexible suction.

In the revised experimental protocol, the
dataset was divided into 1400 training, 331 validation, and 100 held‑out test images, with
all model development experiments conducted using only the training and validation sub‑
sets. We compared a conventional five‑class taxonomy with a task‑oriented binary scheme
and evaluated multiple YOLO26 model scales, architectural modifications, and two repre‑

modified architecture.

Across the three independently trained runs corresponding to seeds

46.1 ± 1.8%, compared with 39.8 ± 4.7% for the YOLO26s baseline.

The method was
evaluated on OralXrays-9, comprising 12,688 panoramic radiographs and 84,099 retained
annotations across nine categories, using a fixed 2688-image hold-out cohort. Twenty-two
detector configurations were compared under a common protocol, and A0–A2 were further
assessed using three independent seeds and paired radiograph-level bootstrap analysis.

### 1. Method
- **Paper A**: The method integrates YOLO11-OBB detection, ellipse-based geometric modeling, and an amodal instance segmentation generative adversarial network (AISGAN) to handle occlusion and provide accurate watermelon size estimation.
- **Paper B**: SBRF-Det extends RP-P4 with a scale-dependent representative-count rule and boundary-conditioned fusion of global representative context with local structural evidence. It retains representative interaction but adds scale-dependent representative allocation, a local depth-wise structural pathway, and boundary-conditioned modulation.

### 2. Dataset / Task
- **Paper A**: The tasks include watermelon size estimation and occlusion handling. The datasets used are Dataset-I and Dataset-II.
- **Paper B**: The task is multi-finding detection in panoramic dental radiographs. The dataset used is OralXrays-9.

### 3. Experimental Results
- **Paper A**: The results reported are a boundary F1-score of 0.959.
- **Paper B**: The results include precision (0.8777), recall (0.8979), mAP50 (0.9152), and mAP50-95 (0.7029). Additionally, SBRF-Det achieved an increase in mAP50-95 by 0.95 percentage points relative to the matched YOLO12l baseline.

### 4. Main Similarities
- Both papers utilize advanced machine learning techniques, specifically involving neural networks and fusion methods.
- Both papers aim to improve detection accuracy in their respective domains.

### 5. Main Differences
- **Methodology**: Paper A focuses on object size estimation and occlusion handling, while Paper B deals with multi-finding detection in dental radiographs.
- **Datasets**: Paper A uses two datasets (Dataset-I and Dataset-II), whereas Paper B uses a single dataset (OralXrays-9).
- **Evaluation Metrics**: Paper A reports a boundary F1-score, while Paper B provides precision, recall, and mAP values.
- **Baseline Comparison**: Paper B includes a comparison with a baseline model (YOLO12l), showing an improvement in mAP50-95, which is not mentioned in Paper A.

### 6. Conclusion
Both papers employ advanced techniques to enhance detection accuracy in their respective fields. However, Paper A focuses on watermelon size estimation and occlusion handling, using multiple datasets, while Paper B addresses multi-finding detection in dental radiographs, using a single dataset and providing detailed performance metrics. The methodologies and evaluation metrics differ significantly, reflecting the distinct nature of the tasks and datasets used.

## Paper Comparison

### 1. Method
- **Paper A (Video-LLaVA):** The method involves aligning images and videos with the textual featurespace before projection, allowing the LLM to learn from a unified visual representation. This approach helps the LLM to understand both images and videos simultaneously and improve its performance in tasks related to visual understanding.
- **Paper B:** Uses SAM 3 with the text prompt 'water' to extract per-frame water-area ratio and normalized waterline level, evaluating quadrant-wise segmentation stability, rain-event detection, false-alarm behavior on negative days, and pixel-level agreement with expert reference masks.

### 2. Dataset / Task
- **Paper A:** Utilizes a diverse set of datasets including MSVD, MSRVTT, TGIF, VisWiz, LLaVA-Bench, and MMBench. The tasks focus on video and image question-answering, as well as zero-shot image question-answering.
- **Paper B:** Employs a specific dataset of 3651 frames from 25 fixed cameras in Zhenjiang, China, spanning four scene categories, seven days in July–September 2026, and all four illumination–weather quadrants. The tasks include quadrant-wise segmentation stability evaluation, rain-event detection, false-alarm behavior on negative days, and pixel-level agreement with expert reference masks.

### 3. Experimental Results
- **Paper A:** Reports that Video-LLaVA outperforms Video-ChatGPT in terms of question-answering accuracy, outperforms MM-GPT across all three POPE hallucination evaluation subsets, achieves superior performance on a broad range of 15 datasets across images and videos, and outperforms LLaVA-1.5 in 8 out of 9 benchmarks.
- **Paper B:** Reports that zero-shot segmentation met the scene-specific validity criterion on 96.9% of the 162 diurnal-cycle frames at the canal reference site (100% in both no-rain quadrants, 88.9% in the night-rain quadrant).

### 4. Main Similarities
- Both papers involve the use of advanced machine learning techniques to process visual data.
- Both papers report results across multiple datasets or benchmarks, indicating a comprehensive evaluation of their methods.

### 5. Main Differences
- **Methodology:** Paper A focuses on aligning images and videos with a textual featurespace to improve visual understanding, while Paper B uses SAM 3 with a specific text prompt to extract water-related information.
- **Datasets and Tasks:** Paper A uses a wide variety of datasets and tasks related to question-answering, while Paper B focuses on a specific urban drainage monitoring network with tasks related to segmentation stability, rain-event detection, and false-alarm behavior.
- **Results:** Paper A provides a broad range of results across multiple benchmarks, while Paper B reports a specific success rate in a single task (scene-specific validity criterion).

### 6. Conclusion
The two papers present distinct approaches to handling visual data, with Paper A focusing on a unified representation for both images and videos, and Paper B concentrating on a specific application of water monitoring in urban drainage systems. Both papers demonstrate the effectiveness of their methods through comprehensive evaluations across multiple datasets and benchmarks, but the specific methodologies and tasks differ significantly.

- **Dataset**: COCO object detection dataset

- **Evaluation Metric**: Relative improvement

本文通过引入残差学习框架，解决了深层网络训练的难题，并在多个图像识别任务中取得了显著的性能提升，证明了该方法的有效性和广泛适用性。

agent.question: 请总结论文《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》的统一视觉表示方法和训练流程。
agent.reference_answer: Video-LLaVA使用LanguageBind图像与视频编码器，使两种视觉表示在投影前对齐到共同的语言特征空间，再经共享投影层与文本token组合送入大语言模型。联合训练的单个batch同时含图像和视频样本；训练包括视觉理解训练和指令微调。前一阶段以自回归目标学习基本视觉理解并冻结其他参数；后一阶段要求响应更复杂的视觉理解指令，LLM也参与训练，最后按不同指令和请求生成回答。

## 1. Research Background

研究背景、核心问题和已有方法局限：
- **核心问题**：当前语言模型（LLM）在处理图像和视频时存在局限性，难以同时理解和处理这两种模态。
- **已有方法局限**：现有方法通常将图像和视频分别处理，缺乏统一的视觉表示学习方法，导致模型在跨模态理解上表现不佳。

## 2. Proposed Method

主要方法、模型结构、核心机制和技术创新：
- **主要方法**：Video-LLaVA通过在投影之前对图像和视频进行对齐，统一视觉表示学习，从而增强语言模型（LLM）对图像和视频的理解能力。
- **模型结构**：Video-LLaVA采用统一的视觉表示学习框架，将图像和视频特征对齐后投影到语言特征空间。
- **核心机制**：通过在训练过程中对齐图像和视频特征，使得模型能够更好地学习跨模态的统一表示，从而提高对图像和视频的理解能力。
- **技术创新**：提出了一种简单但稳健的LVLM（Language-Visual Model）基线，能够同时处理图像和视频数据，实现相互增强。

### Experiment 1: 视频问答

- **Dataset**：MSVD, MSRVTT, TGIF
- **Training Setup**：未提供足够信息
- **Evaluation Metric**：问题回答准确性

### Experiment 2: 图像理解

- **Dataset**：MSRVTT, MSVD, TGIF, ActivityNet
- **Training Setup**：未提供足够信息
- **Evaluation Metric**：question-answering accuracy

## 4. Experimental Results

### Experiment 1: 视频问答

- **Main Result**：Video-LLaVA在问题回答准确性上优于Video-ChatGPT。

### Experiment 2: 图像理解

- **Comparison**：Video-LLaVA在MSRVTT、MSVD、TGIF和ActivityNet上的question-answering accuracy分别比Video-ChatGPT高出5.8%、9.9%、18.6%和10.1%。

## 5. Main Contributions

- **主要贡献**：提出了一种新的统一视觉表示学习方法Video-LLaVA，通过在投影之前对齐图像和视频特征，显著提高了语言模型在图像和视频理解任务上的表现。

本文提出了一种新的统一视觉表示学习方法Video-LLaVA，通过在训练过程中对齐图像和视频特征，显著提高了语言模型在图像和视频理解任务上的表现。实验结果表明，Video-LLaVA在多个数据集上的表现优于现有模型，展示了其在跨模态理解上的强大能力。

agent.reference_answer: 实际比较DenseNet201、EfficientNetB7、InceptionV3、ResNet152V2、InceptionResNetV2和VGG16。第4节使用ILSVRC2012数据，以Top-K准确率评估，每种方法运行5次取平均。结果是EfficientNetB7在Top1最好，ResNet152V2在Top2、Top3最好；这两种方法的Top3均超过0.8。尽管题名讨论语义分割，文中该实验报告的是图像类别Top-K指标，不能把它直接当作像素级分割mIoU。

agent.question: 请总结论文《Multi-View Semantic–Geometric Perception for Post-Disaster Flexible Suction with Metric 3D Scene Reconstruction》的输入、三个处理模块和输出。
agent.reference_answer: 输入为机械臂相机采集的同步多视角RGB图像。三个模块为轻量障碍物实例分割、具有物理尺度的3D场景重建、带约束的吸取点选择。YOLO-LiteSeg生成语义实例掩码，VGGT预测相机参数与深度并重建场景，之后进行尺度对齐，将2D障碍物标签投影到3D点云。输出为满足预设吸取深度与最大化最小障碍物间距准则的吸取点参考；该参考不等于完整吸取轨迹或过程的全局最优方案。

The framework takes synchronized RGB im-
age sequences acquired from multiple arm-mounted camera positions as input and com-
prises  three  coupled  modules:  lightweight  obstacle  instance  segmentation,  metric  3D 
scene reconstruction, and constraint-based suction-point selection.

YOLO-LiteSeg gener-
ates class-labeled 2D instance masks that provide semantic cues for subsequent projection-
based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer, while VGGT independently predicts camera pa-
rameters and dense depth from the RGB images for multi-view reconstruction, followed 
by metric alignment of the reconstructed scene.

Finally, semantic labels from 
the  2D  obstacle  instance  masks  are  transferred  to  the  corresponding  reconstructed  3D 
points,  and  the  resulting metric  3D  scene  representation  integrating  obstacle  semantics 
and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.

yielding a selected suction-point reference rather than a 
global optimum for the complete suction trajectory or process.

agent.reference_answer: TSCFFM-AOABI先用Blur、MedianBlur、ToGray和CLAHE增强图像，再用Adam训练的YOLO11s分割牙齿实例。DenseNet201、MobileNet和ShuffleNetV2提取分割区域的互补特征并融合，由KELM分类，BCO优化KELM惩罚参数C和RBF核参数γ。论文使用包含598张牙科X光图像与32类牙齿的基准集，报告准确率96.17%、精确率95.10%、召回率99.03%和F1 98.00%；这些是该数据集实验报告，不能直接等同于临床部署效果。

Methods: The proposed frame work first 
applies image augmentation using Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and Contrast -Limited 
Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to improve image variability and feature vis-
ibility. Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer.

The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

Results: The proposed framework is evaluated on a benchmark dental X-ray image 
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes. Experimental results demonstrate an 
accuracy of 96.17%, precision of 95.10%, recall of 99.03%, and an F1-score of 98.00%.

object detection with stereo vision to estimate traffic cone positions relative to the camera
coordinate system.

For this the cone collector program collects 50 consecutive measurements and calcu-
lates their average. The experiment results showed that this number is a balance between
fast execution and high accuracy.

positioning accuracy for reliable cone grasping.

The system utilizes the collaborative features

grasping operation, allowing automatic validation of a successful cone grasp.

YOLO11-OBB is used to provide rotation-aware localization for inference in this study.
The oriented bounding boxes are converted into ellipse-based geometric priors that guide

interpretations and reducing underestimation. Figure 5c shows this process, where two
ellipses are generated from different minor-axis points and merged to form the final
reconstructed shape.

## Paper Comparison

### 1. Method
**Paper A** describes a vision-guided robotic manipulation system for traffic cone handling. The method involves using a Doosan M1013 collaborative robot manipulator equipped with an OnRobot RG2 gripper and a custom-designed grasping attachment. Vision processing is executed on a Rudi-AGX embedded computer, while high-level control and system coordination tasks are performed on a separate onboard computer. Communication between subsystems is facilitated using the ROS2 Humble framework. The vision subsystem combines deep-learning-based object detection with stereovision to estimate traffic cone positions relative to the camera coordinate system, with the cone position data transmitted to the manipulator control framework through ROS2 communication.

**Paper B** presents a method for occlusion-aware watermelon size estimation using a combination of YOLO11-OBB detection, ellipse-based geometric modeling, and an amodal instance segmentation generative adversarial network (AISGAN). AISGAN is employed to reconstruct complete watermelon shapes from occluded regions using a conditional GAN framework.

### 2. Dataset / Task
**Paper A** does not mention any specific datasets or tasks beyond the general tasks of vision-guided manipulation of traffic cones, detection and localization of traffic cones, and control of a collaborative robotic arm for traffic cone handling.

**Paper B** mentions two datasets (Dataset-I and Dataset-II) and focuses on the tasks of watermelon size estimation and handling occlusions.

### 3. Experimental Results
**Paper A** does not report any experimental results.

**Paper B** reports a boundary F1-score of 0.959 for the watermelon size estimation task.

### 4. Main Similarities
- Both papers utilize machine learning techniques for their respective tasks.
- Both involve the use of computer vision for object detection and localization.

### 5. Main Differences
- **Application Domain**: Paper A focuses on traffic cone manipulation, while Paper B focuses on watermelon size estimation.
- **Methodology**: Paper A uses a collaborative robotic arm with vision processing and ROS2 communication, whereas Paper B employs YOLO11-OBB, ellipse-based geometric modeling, and an amodal GAN.
- **Results**: Paper A does not report any results, while Paper B reports a specific metric (boundary F1-score) for its task.

### 6. Conclusion
The two papers differ significantly in their application domains, methodologies, and reported results. While both leverage machine learning and computer vision techniques, Paper A focuses on robotic manipulation tasks, whereas Paper B addresses the challenge of occlusion handling in size estimation. The lack of reported results in Paper A makes it difficult to compare its performance directly with Paper B.

agent.reference_answer: 输电设备论文使用配准的可见光与红外图像，采用双流结构、共享/专属特征交互与热感知门控融合，得到融合表示并供YOLO检测结构和热异常。排水监控论文输入固定监控摄像头图像，以SAM 3及water文本提示进行零样本分割，提取水面积比例与归一化水线，结合规则进行降雨/积水事件与误报分析。香云纱论文构建1831张缺陷图像的数据集，验证集选择YOLO26s-DWR + DynamicConv，用缺陷位置支持人工设计干预；其流程是设计决策支持，量化减废和生命周期收益仍待验证。

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

Experiments are conducted on a spatially aligned infrared–visible dataset
containing normal insulator strings, normal strain clamps, damaged insulator strings,
insulator thermal faults, and strain clamp thermal faults.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

we constructed a specialized Xiangyunsha defect‑image
dataset comprising 1831 annotated images.

Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑
ity control system. This study demonstrates the feasibility of linking defect localization
with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

agent.reference_answer: ViT缺少CNN的局部性和平移等变性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化会受到影响；这说明小数据训练结果依赖数据规模，不能直接否定该架构。论文在更大预训练集上看到更强结果：ViT-Large在ImageNet预训练下不如ViT-Base，ImageNet-21k下相近，JFT-300M下才显现大模型的完整收益。该结论限定于论文的模型与实验，不能推成任意数据规模下ViT都优于CNN。

agent.question: 论文《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》为什么同时引入双向SSM和位置嵌入？它们分别处理什么问题？
agent.reference_answer: 论文将原始Mamba用于视觉的困难概括为单向建模和缺乏位置感知。双向SSM用于依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模；位置嵌入为视觉识别提供位置信息，在密集预测中体现空间感知。它们是不同问题的对应设计，不能把双向性理解为代替位置信息。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

Furthermore, the position embedding in Vim
block provides the awareness for spatial information, which
enables Vim to be more robust in dense prediction tasks.

agent.answer:
《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》引入双向SSM是为了解决Mamba的单向建模问题，而引入位置嵌入是为了克服Mamba缺乏位置感知的问题。

具体来说，双向SSM通过在每个块中添加额外的双向SSM，使得视觉序列在正向和反向方向上都能被处理，从而解决了单向建模的挑战。位置嵌入则通过将图像视为由补丁组成的序列，为每个位置提供嵌入，解决了位置感知不足的问题。

因此，双向SSM和位置嵌入分别解决了单向建模和位置感知的问题。

According to the paper, linear probing is more resource-efficient, but it is not recommended as a replacement for end-to-end fine-tuning evaluation. The paper states that linear probing is not a representative method of end-to-end fine-tuning, and therefore, it is not suitable for a representative benchmark. Specifically, the paper mentions that the correlation coefficient of 0.38 suggests that freezing the encoders significantly changes the performance ranking, and thus, end-to-end fine-tuning is recommended over linear probing for a representative benchmark.

The key points from the evidence are:
1. Linear probing is efficient but not representative of end-to-end fine-tuning.
2. Freezing the encoders significantly changes the performance ranking, indicating that linear probing does not accurately reflect the performance of end-to-end fine-tuning.
3. The recommended benchmarking setup enables a performance analysis of vision foundation models for semantic segmentation, highlighting the importance of end-to-end fine-tuning.

Therefore, linear probing is more resource-efficient but still not recommended as a replacement for end-to-end fine-tuning evaluation.

agent.question: 根据《SBRF-Det: Scale-Boundary Representative Fusion for Multi-Finding Detection in Panoramic Dental Radiographs》，为什么边界相关局部信息对mAP50-95比仅正确分类更关键？请结合正文中的局部与全局融合解释。
agent.reference_answer: mAP50-95要求在逐渐严格的IoU阈值下仍有准确边界框重叠，正确类别本身不足以获得较高指标。局部信息保留病灶边缘、修复体界面、牙根等结构线索，可以影响框几何；全局上下文帮助区分外观相似而解剖位置不同的发现。边界门控对局部分支增强调节更强、对全局分支仅适度衰减，以兼顾边界定位与语义上下文。

gold_evidence.evidence:
A strong boundary response increases
the local contribution while only moderately attenuating the global branch.

Global context
helps distinguish visually similar structures that occur in different anatomical settings,
while local evidence is retained around lesion margins, restoration interfaces, root struc-
tures, and other high-frequency regions. The P4 placement further preserves a spatial
resolution at which these cues can influence box geometry. This design is particularly
relevant to mAP50-95, where correct class prediction alone is insufficient and bounding-box
overlap must remain accurate across progressively stricter IoU thresholds.

agent.answer:
根据提供的论文原文，SBRF-Det 通过结合局部结构证据和全局上下文信息，提高了多发现象检测的性能。具体来说，SBRF-Det 通过以下方式改进了检测性能：

and other thermally related faults. However, visible images are sensitive to illumination,

gold_evidence.evidence: To do so, we split an image into patches and provide the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Trans- former. retrieval.reference_answer: 推荐对VFM的ViT-B版本进行微调，采用16×16 patch和线性解码器。摘要称该设置能代表更大模型、更复杂解码器和更小patch的排序，同时将训练时间减少超过13倍。

gold_evidence.evidence: the recommendation is to fine- tune the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a 16 × 16 patch size and a linear decoder, as these settings are representative of using a larger model, more advanced decoder and smaller patch size, while reducing training time by more than 13 times.

retrieval.reference_answer: 参数量从27.24 M降至2.61 M；GFLOPs从52.37降至5.47；推理时间为4.56 ms。这些结果来自九种模拟条件。

gold_evidence.evidence: Across nine simulated conditions, YOLO-LiteSeg reduced parameters from 27.24 M to 2.61 M and giga floating-point operations from 52.37 to 5.47, while achieving 99.02% mean average precision at 0.50 intersection over union and 84.36% across thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, with 4.56 ms inference.

Ex- periments are repeated thrice with different random seeds, and the average performance is reported along with the standard deviation.

retrieval.question: 比较《Attention Is All You Need》和《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》：两篇论文如何把输入组织成序列，输出任务有何不同？请区分语言序列与图像块序列，并说明共同的注意力架构思路。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Transformer用于序列转换，以编码器—解码器和注意力处理输入、输出序列，原论文主要验证机器翻译。ViT将图像切为固定大小的块，进行线性嵌入、加位置嵌入后送入标准Transformer编码器，额外可学习分类token用于图像分类。二者共享序列表示和注意力思路，输入单元及输出任务不同，不能把ViT说成翻译解码器。

gold_evidence.evidence:
We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer,
based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
entirely.

Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to
be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly
less time to train.
Most competitive neural sequence transduction models have an encoder-decoder structure [5, 2, 35].

Model overview. We split an image into ﬁxed-size patches, linearly embed each of them,
add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer
encoder. In order to perform classiﬁcation, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable
“classiﬁcation token” to the sequence.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：ResNet以F(x)=H(x)-x重写残差映射，通过恒等shortcut将输入加到残差输出上，缓解更深网络的优化/退化问题。ViT的图像特定归纳偏置少于CNN；CNN内置局部性、二维邻域和平移等变性，而ViT更多从数据中学习空间关系，通常在大数据集预训练后迁移到较小下游任务。不能据此声称ResNet完全不需要训练数据，也不能脱离训练规模直接判定架构普遍优劣。

underlying mapping as H(x), we let the stacked nonlinear
layers ﬁt another mapping of F(x): = H(x) − x. The orig-
inal mapping is recast into F(x)+ x.

In our case, the shortcut connections simply
perform identity mapping, and their outputs are added to
the outputs of the stacked layers (Fig. 2).

We note that Vision Transformer has much less image-speciﬁc inductive bias than
CNNs. In CNNs, locality, two-dimensional neighborhood structure, and translation equivariance are
baked into each layer throughout the whole model.
Typically, we pre-train ViT on large datasets, and ﬁne-tune to (smaller) downstream tasks.

retrieval.question: 比较《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》和《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》：它们融合哪些输入信息、在哪一层完成对齐或交互、最终输出用于什么任务？请区分统一视觉—语言表征与红外—可见光图像融合。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Video-LLaVA用LanguageBind图像/视频编码器先对齐到共享语言特征空间，再使用共享投影层，把视觉表示和文本查询送入LLM生成语言回答。热感知方法用可见光和红外双分支分别提取结构纹理与热响应，以共享—特有表征及交互融合互补信息，以热感知门控强化热异常并保留结构，输出融合图像用于输电设备缺陷检测。二者输入模态、对齐空间及下游输出不同。

gold_evidence.evidence:
By shar-
ing a language feature space, the image and video
representations ultimately converge into a unified
visual feature space, which we refer to as emergent
alignment of images and videos. Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

Subsequently, the unified visual representation is
encoded by shared projection layers, which is then
combined with tokenized textual queries and fed
into a large language model to generate correspond-
ing responses.

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

retrieval.question: 比较《Zero-Shot Water Monitoring from Fixed Drainage Surveillance Imagery Across Day/Night and Rain/No-Rain Conditions: A SAM 3 Benchmark at 25 Urban Sites》和《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》：二者对基础模型采用了什么适配方式，验证目标有什么不同？如何理解水面监测中的零样本分割与语义分割基准中的监督微调建议？
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：水面监测用已有SAM 3及water提示做零样本分割，不做任务特定训练/标注来适配模型，提取水面积和水线指标，评价昼夜/雨情稳定性、事件检测、负样本误报及与专家掩膜的一致性。CVPRW基准考察VFM的语义分割监督微调，强调端到端微调的代表性，不推荐以线性探测替代它。特定水面场景零样本有效不表示通用多类分割无需微调；专家参考掩膜用于评价也不等于用于训练模型。

gold_evidence.evidence:
This paper investigates whether a promptable segmentation founda‑
tion model can monitor water surfaces and waterlogging zero‑shot—without any task‑
specific training or labeling—across the full illumination–weather spectrum of real surveil‑
lance operations.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

Recent vision foundation models (VFMs) have demon-
strated proficiency in various tasks but require supervised
fine-tuning to perform the task of semantic segmentation ef-
fectively.

Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

Panoramic dental radiographs frequently contain multiple coexisting patho-
logical, anatomical, and treatment-related findings that vary in scale, contrast, and bound-
ary definition.

We propose
SBRF-Det, a one-stage multi-finding detector integrating scale-dependent representative al-
location with boundary-conditioned local–global feature fusion at P4/16.

Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer. The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：路锥系统在ROS2中使用YOLO位置、多次测量均值与初始/目标上方/必要时中间观察位姿改善定位，抓取前后负载差用于验证，失败可重试。抽吸方案用YOLO-LiteSeg和VGGT构建米制三维语义场景，以物理深度及障碍净空选择抽吸点。路锥研究含抓取反馈闭环，抽吸研究给出满足预设约束的选点参考；不能把感知/选点验证扩大为已完成完整灾后自主作业验证。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The system operates within a ROS2-based frame-
work and utilizes object position data provided by a YOLO-based vision subsystem. To
improve localization accuracy, multiple measurements are collected and averaged before
grasp planning. The grasping sequence is executed through predefined observation poses,
including an initial detection position and a secondary pose above the target. When the
cone is detected outside the optimal observation region, an additional intermediate obser-
vation pose is generated to further reduce localization errors.

Grasp reliability is enhanced
through a weight-based validation method utilizing the collaborative robot’s built-in force
sensing capability. The measured load before and after grasping is compared, and unsuc-
cessful grasps automatically trigger up to three retry attempts.

YOLO-LiteSeg provides obstacle instance masks, while 
Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) provides depth and camera parameters 
for multi-view reconstruction; checkerboard-based metric alignment converts reconstruc-
tion to physical scale. Projection-based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer produces an ob-
stacle-highlighted metric 3D scene representation for constraint-based suction-point se-
lection.

The resulting 3D representation generated suction-point references satisfying 
predeﬁned suction-depth and obstacle-clearance criteria, providing metrically interpreta-
ble spatial information for post-disaster ﬂexible suction.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：香云纱研究分训练、验证、独立留出测试集，模型开发仅用训练/验证，按三个预定义种子的验证结果选架构，再报告对应独立训练的留出测试均值与标准差。SBRF-Det采用共同协议和固定留出队列，对A0–A2用三个独立种子，并进行成对影像级bootstrap差异分析。共同点是保留最终评价、检查稳定性；区别在选型过程与统计方法。数据和对象不同，mAP数值不能直接比较方法优劣。

gold_evidence.evidence:
In the revised experimental protocol, the
dataset was divided into 1400 training, 331 validation, and 100 held‑out test images, with
all model development experiments conducted using only the training and validation sub‑
sets. We compared a conventional five‑class taxonomy with a task‑oriented binary scheme
and evaluated multiple YOLO26 model scales, architectural modifications, and two repre‑
sentative lightweight YOLO detectors. Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

Across the three independently trained runs corresponding to seeds
0, 42, and 123, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv achieved a mean held‑out test mAP@0.5 of
46.1 ± 1.8%, compared with 39.8 ± 4.7% for the YOLO26s baseline.

The method was
evaluated on OralXrays-9, comprising 12,688 panoramic radiographs and 84,099 retained
annotations across nine categories, using a fixed 2688-image hold-out cohort. Twenty-two
detector configurations were compared under a common protocol, and A0–A2 were further
assessed using three independent seeds and paired radiograph-level bootstrap analysis.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：热感知融合综合可见光结构缺陷与红外热异常，融合图像交给统一YOLO检测器服务设备缺陷识别，实验支持检测表征改善。香云纱将传统缺陷视作设计资源，定位结果支持工匠和设计者定向印染及局部裁切，是人主导决策支持。香云纱的定量节材、外部泛化和生命周期收益仍待验证；检测成绩不能直接表述为已证明减废效益或自主质量控制效果，二者业务目标不同。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Infrared and visible images provide complementary information for transmission equip-
ment inspection, but a single modality is often insufficient to simultaneously represent
structural defects and thermal abnormalities.

When the
fused images are evaluated using a unified YOLO-based detector, the proposed thermal-
aware fusion framework achieves precision, recall, and mAP at IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936,
0.921, and 0.943, respectively. These results indicate that the proposed thermal-aware fusion
framework can effectively integrate visible structural information and infrared thermal
response information and improve the recognition of transmission equipment defects in
complex inspection scenarios.

Beyond detection, we
further conducted a descriptive design case study in which localized Xiangyunsha surface
irregularities informed human‑led design interventions, including targeted artistic print‑
ing/dyeing for textile_abnormal regions and localized pattern cutting for Stain_Patch re‑
gions. The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑
ity control system. This study demonstrates the feasibility of linking defect localization
with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：牙齿框架在同一牙科X光的分割牙区上，以DenseNet201、MobileNet、ShuffleNetV2提取互补深度特征并融合，由BCO调参的KELM进行牙类分类，互补性来自不同特征提取模型。热感知方法从可见光与红外两种输入提取结构纹理和热响应，融合共享/模态特有信息并进行热感知门控，融合图像用于YOLO缺陷检测，互补性来自传感模态。多模型特征融合不能说成红外—可见光双模态融合。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

When the
fused images are evaluated using a unified YOLO-based detector, the proposed thermal-
aware fusion framework achieves precision, recall, and mAP at IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936,
0.921, and 0.943, respectively.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：牙齿框架在同一牙科X光的分割牙区上，以DenseNet201、MobileNet、ShuffleNetV2提取互补深度特征并融合，由BCO调参的KELM进行牙类分类，互补性来自不同特征提取模型。热感知方法从可见光与红外两种输入提取结构纹理和热响应，融合共享/模态特有信息并进行热感知门控，融合图像用于YOLO缺陷检测，互补性来自传感模态。多模型特征融合不能说成红外—可见光双模态融合。

The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

When the
fused images are evaluated using a unified YOLO-based detector, the proposed thermal-
aware fusion framework achieves precision, recall, and mAP at IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936,
0.921, and 0.943, respectively.

“classiﬁcation token” to the sequence.

retrieval.reference_answer: 论文针对把Mamba用于视觉时的单向建模和位置感知不足，提出Vim：图像切patch并线性投影，加入位置嵌入，用双向选择性状态空间块进行依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模。先在ImageNet监督图像分类上训练，再将骨干用于语义分割、目标检测和实例分割。状态空间计算随序列长度线性增长，与全局自注意力的二次增长形成效率差异；论文报告的优势应限定在其任务、模型和实验设置内。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

We first
split the input image into patches and linearly project them
as vectors to Vim. Image patches are treated as the sequence
data in Vim blocks, which efficiently compresses the vi-
sual representation with the proposed bidirectional selective
state space.

In
the current stage, we train the Vim model on the supervised
image classification task using the ImageNet dataset and
then use the pretrained Vim as the backbone to perform
sequential visual representation learning for downstream
dense prediction tasks, i.e., semantic segmentation, object
detection, and instance segmentation.

where self-attention is quadratic to sequence length M, and
SSM is linear to sequence length M (N is a fixed parameter,
set to 16 by default).

retrieval.reference_answer: Video-LLaVA使用LanguageBind图像与视频编码器，使两种视觉表示在投影前对齐到共同的语言特征空间，再经共享投影层与文本token组合送入大语言模型。联合训练的单个batch同时含图像和视频样本；训练包括视觉理解训练和指令微调。前一阶段以自回归目标学习基本视觉理解并冻结其他参数；后一阶段要求响应更复杂的视觉理解指令，LLM也参与训练，最后按不同指令和请求生成回答。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

We dynami-
cally conduct joint training on images and videos,
wherein a single batch contains both image and
video samples simultaneously.

The training objective of this
stage is the original auto-regressive loss, where the
model learns the basic ability to view the vision.
We freeze the other parameters of the model during
this process.

In this stage, the model is required to provide
responses corresponding to different instructions.
These instructions often involve more complex
visual comprehension tasks, rather than just de-
scribing visual signals.

After this stage, the model learns to generate
corresponding responses based on different instruc-
tions and requests. The LLM are also involved in
training at this stage.

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《How to choose a suitable method in image semantic segmentation-An Experimental Study》实际比较的六种方法、实验数据与评价指标、主要结果。
retrieval.reference_answer: 实际比较DenseNet201、EfficientNetB7、InceptionV3、ResNet152V2、InceptionResNetV2和VGG16。第4节使用ILSVRC2012数据，以Top-K准确率评估，每种方法运行5次取平均。结果是EfficientNetB7在Top1最好，ResNet152V2在Top2、Top3最好；这两种方法的Top3均超过0.8。尽管题名讨论语义分割，文中该实验报告的是图像类别Top-K指标，不能把它直接当作像素级分割mIoU。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The data sets used in this paper are the one used in
ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012
(ILSVRC2012).Top-K accuracy rate is used as an
evaluation index

specifically six methods including
DenseNet201, EfficientNetB7, InceptionResNetV2,
InceptionV3, ResNet152V2 and VGG16.

Based on the data sets, experiments were conducted on all 6
methods, with each method running 5 times, and the average
of the experimental results was taken as the final result.

As shown in the figure, EfficientNetB7 performs best in
Top1 accuracy, but is surpassed by ResNet152V2 in Top2
and Top3 accuracies. Although DenseNet201 has lower
accuracy in Top 1 compared to other methods, its
performance on Top2 and Top 3 is similar to those of
InceptionV3 and VGG16. In summary, EfficientNetB7 and
ResNet152V2 perform well, the Top3 accuracy both
exceeding 0.8

retrieval.reference_answer: 输入为机械臂相机采集的同步多视角RGB图像。三个模块为轻量障碍物实例分割、具有物理尺度的3D场景重建、带约束的吸取点选择。YOLO-LiteSeg生成语义实例掩码，VGGT预测相机参数与深度并重建场景，之后进行尺度对齐，将2D障碍物标签投影到3D点云。输出为满足预设吸取深度与最大化最小障碍物间距准则的吸取点参考；该参考不等于完整吸取轨迹或过程的全局最优方案。

age sequences acquired from multiple arm-mounted camera positions as input and com-
prises  three  coupled  modules:  lightweight  obstacle  instance  segmentation,  metric  3D 
scene reconstruction, and constraint-based suction-point selection.

YOLO-LiteSeg gener-
ates class-labeled 2D instance masks that provide semantic cues for subsequent projection-
based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer, while VGGT independently predicts camera pa-
rameters and dense depth from the RGB images for multi-view reconstruction, followed 
by metric alignment of the reconstructed scene.

Finally, semantic labels from 
the  2D  obstacle  instance  masks  are  transferred  to  the  corresponding  reconstructed  3D 
points,  and  the  resulting metric  3D  scene  representation  integrating  obstacle  semantics 
and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.

yielding a selected suction-point reference rather than a 
global optimum for the complete suction trajectory or process.

Methods: The proposed frame work first 
applies image augmentation using Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and Contrast -Limited 
Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to improve image variability and feature vis-
ibility. Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer.

The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

Results: The proposed framework is evaluated on a benchmark dental X-ray image 
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes. Experimental results demonstrate an 
accuracy of 96.17%, precision of 95.10%, recall of 99.03%, and an F1-score of 98.00%.

extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

Experiments are conducted on a spatially aligned infrared–visible dataset
containing normal insulator strings, normal strain clamps, damaged insulator strings,

pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

retrieval.reference_answer: ViT缺少CNN的局部性和平移等变性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化会受到影响；这说明小数据训练结果依赖数据规模，不能直接否定该架构。论文在更大预训练集上看到更强结果：ViT-Large在ImageNet预训练下不如ViT-Base，ImageNet-21k下相近，JFT-300M下才显现大模型的完整收益。该结论限定于论文的模型与实验，不能推成任意数据规模下ViT都优于CNN。

gold_evidence.evidence:
inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well

retrieval.question: 论文《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》为什么同时引入双向SSM和位置嵌入？它们分别处理什么问题？
retrieval.reference_answer: 论文将原始Mamba用于视觉的困难概括为单向建模和缺乏位置感知。双向SSM用于依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模；位置嵌入为视觉识别提供位置信息，在密集预测中体现空间感知。它们是不同问题的对应设计，不能把双向性理解为代替位置信息。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

Furthermore, the position embedding in Vim
block provides the awareness for spatial information, which
enables Vim to be more robust in dense prediction tasks.

Current VFMs
may not acquire enough spatial semantic understanding in
pretraining to perform semantic segmentation effectively

though linear probing is efficient, end-to-end fine-tuning is
recommended for a representative benchmark.

retrieval.question: 根据《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》，为什么可见光与红外需要互补融合，而简单平均仍有局限？
retrieval.reference_answer: 可见光提供轮廓、纹理与结构异常，但受光照、背景和遮挡影响；红外能揭示异常发热，却缺少丰富纹理且结构边界模糊。简单平均能加入两种信息，但平等对待所有模态和位置，不考虑模态特性、空间重要性与热响应分布。论文因此采用热感知门控和共享/专属特征交互；在该文同协议检测对比中，提出方法的mAP@0.5:0.95为0.657，简单平均为0.597，不能把该结果外推到所有融合任务。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Visible images provide rich appear-
ance, contour, and texture information and are therefore suitable for identifying structural
abnormalities such as damage, cracks, deformation, and foreign object attachment. Infrared
images provide complementary thermal response information and are particularly use-
ful for revealing abnormal heating associated with poor contact, insulation degradation,
and other thermally related faults. However, visible images are sensitive to illumination,
background interference, and occlusion, whereas infrared images generally provide limited
texture details and relatively blurred structural boundaries [4].

However, simple averaging treats visible and infrared information equally and does
not consider modality-specific characteristics, spatial importance, or thermal response
distribution. The proposed fused representation achieves precision, recall, and mAP at
IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936, 0.921, and 0.943, respectively. Compared with simple average
fusion, the proposed framework improves mAP at IoU = 0.5:0.95 from 0.597 to 0.657,
corresponding to an absolute improvement of 0.060.

retrieval.reference_answer: 2D掩码提供障碍物语义，但不能直接给出物理高度、坡度或障碍物间距。吸取深度、沉积厚度、距离等是有单位的量，未定尺度的重建不能直接应用这些约束。论文将YOLO-LiteSeg语义与VGGT几何结合，用棋盘格对齐到物理尺度并将2D标签转到3D点云，在吸取深度和最大化最小障碍物间距准则下生成参考点。

gold_evidence.evidence:
image-plane masks alone 
cannot provide physical height, surface slope, or obstacle clearance, while geometry with-
out semantics cannot distinguish obstacle regions from obstacle-free sludge regions.

For ﬂexible suction, the reconstructed geometry must addi-
tionally be converted to physical scale because sludge-deposit thickness, height proﬁles, 
obstacle distances, and suction depth are metric quantities rather than scale-ambiguous 
geometric descriptors.

Finally, semantic labels from 
the  2D  obstacle  instance  masks  are  transferred  to  the  corresponding  reconstructed  3D 
points,  and  the  resulting metric  3D  scene  representation  integrating  obstacle  semantics 
and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.

retrieval.reference_answer: 普通可见区域分割会在遮挡时产生不完整掩码，导致尺寸低估。论文用AISGAN重建完整水果几何；YOLO11-OBB输出旋转感知位置并转换为椭圆先验，引导非模态重建应对不同方向。双椭圆后处理结合两种边界解释，在不对称遮挡下提高形状补全的稳健性、减少低估。

used to enhance robustness under asymmetric occlusion by capturing alternative boundary
interpretations and reducing underestimation. Figure 5c shows this process, where two
ellipses are generated from different minor-axis points and merged to form the final
reconstructed shape.

retrieval.question: 《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》如何把图像转换为 Transformer 的输入？训练任务是什么？
retrieval.reference_answer: 先将图像分成 patch，对每个 patch 作线性嵌入，将这些嵌入组成序列输入 Transformer；图像 patch 被当作 NLP 中的 token 处理。模型以监督方式训练执行图像分类。

gold_evidence.evidence: To do so, we split an image into patches and provide the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Trans- former. Image patches are treated the same way as tokens (words) in an NLP application. We train the model on image classification in supervised fashion.

retrieval.reference_answer: 推荐对VFM的ViT-B版本进行微调，采用16×16 patch和线性解码器。摘要称该设置能代表更大模型、更复杂解码器和更小patch的排序，同时将训练时间减少超过13倍。

gold_evidence.evidence: the recommendation is to fine- tune the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a 16 × 16 patch size and a linear decoder, as these settings are representative of using a larger model, more advanced decoder and smaller patch size, while reducing training time by more than 13 times.

retrieval.reference_answer: 参数量从27.24 M降至2.61 M；GFLOPs从52.37降至5.47；推理时间为4.56 ms。这些结果来自九种模拟条件。

gold_evidence.evidence: Across nine simulated conditions, YOLO-LiteSeg reduced parameters from 27.24 M to 2.61 M and giga floating-point operations from 52.37 to 5.47, while achieving 99.02% mean average precision at 0.50 intersection over union and 84.36% across thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, with 4.56 ms inference.

retrieval.question: 《Vision-Guided Cone Manipulation with Collaborative Robotic Arm》如何用重量验证抓取成功？抓取失败最多会自动重试几次？
retrieval.reference_answer: 利用协作机械臂内置力传感能力，比较抓取前后测得的负载进行重量验证；失败抓取最多自动触发三次重试。

gold_evidence.evidence: Grasp reliability is enhanced through a weight-based validation method utilizing the collaborative robot’s built-in force sensing capability. The measured load before and after grasping is compared, and unsuc- cessful grasps automatically trigger up to three retry attempts.

retrieval.question: 《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》的实验协议规定 ADE20K、PASCAL VOC、Cityscapes、GTA V 各训练多少步？有效 batch size 和随机种子重复次数是多少？
retrieval.reference_answer: ADE20K训练40,000步；PASCAL VOC、Cityscapes和GTA V各20,000步。实际batch size=1，通过梯度累积将有效batch size提至16；每个实验使用不同随机种子重复3次，报告均值与标准差。

gold_evidence.evidence: The batch size is set to 1 to make training more accessible by reducing the mem- ory requirements. Through gradient accumulation the effec- tive batch size is increased to 16 to align with Mask2Former. The number of training steps is set to 40,000 for ADE20K, and 20,000 for PASCAL VOC, Cityscapes and GTA V . Ex- periments are repeated thrice with different random seeds, and the average performance is reported along with the standard deviation.

Ex- periments are repeated thrice with different random seeds, and the average performance is reported along with the standard deviation.

retrieval.question: 比较《Attention Is All You Need》和《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》：两篇论文如何把输入组织成序列，输出任务有何不同？请区分语言序列与图像块序列，并说明共同的注意力架构思路。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Transformer用于序列转换，以编码器—解码器和注意力处理输入、输出序列，原论文主要验证机器翻译。ViT将图像切为固定大小的块，进行线性嵌入、加位置嵌入后送入标准Transformer编码器，额外可学习分类token用于图像分类。二者共享序列表示和注意力思路，输入单元及输出任务不同，不能把ViT说成翻译解码器。

gold_evidence.evidence:
We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer,
based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
entirely.

Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to
be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly
less time to train.
Most competitive neural sequence transduction models have an encoder-decoder structure [5, 2, 35].

Model overview. We split an image into ﬁxed-size patches, linearly embed each of them,
add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer
encoder. In order to perform classiﬁcation, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable
“classiﬁcation token” to the sequence.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Transformer用于序列转换，以编码器—解码器和注意力处理输入、输出序列，原论文主要验证机器翻译。ViT将图像切为固定大小的块，进行线性嵌入、加位置嵌入后送入标准Transformer编码器，额外可学习分类token用于图像分类。二者共享序列表示和注意力思路，输入单元及输出任务不同，不能把ViT说成翻译解码器。

We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer,
based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
entirely.

Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to
be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly
less time to train.
Most competitive neural sequence transduction models have an encoder-decoder structure [5, 2, 35].

Model overview. We split an image into ﬁxed-size patches, linearly embed each of them,
add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer
encoder. In order to perform classiﬁcation, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable
“classiﬁcation token” to the sequence.

retrieval.question: 比较《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》和《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》：它们融合哪些输入信息、在哪一层完成对齐或交互、最终输出用于什么任务？请区分统一视觉—语言表征与红外—可见光图像融合。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Video-LLaVA用LanguageBind图像/视频编码器先对齐到共享语言特征空间，再使用共享投影层，把视觉表示和文本查询送入LLM生成语言回答。热感知方法用可见光和红外双分支分别提取结构纹理与热响应，以共享—特有表征及交互融合互补信息，以热感知门控强化热异常并保留结构，输出融合图像用于输电设备缺陷检测。二者输入模态、对齐空间及下游输出不同。

gold_evidence.evidence:
By shar-
ing a language feature space, the image and video
representations ultimately converge into a unified
visual feature space, which we refer to as emergent
alignment of images and videos. Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

Subsequently, the unified visual representation is
encoded by shared projection layers, which is then
combined with tokenized textual queries and fed
into a large language model to generate correspond-
ing responses.

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

ing a language feature space, the image and video
representations ultimately converge into a unified
visual feature space, which we refer to as emergent
alignment of images and videos. Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

encoded by shared projection layers, which is then
combined with tokenized textual queries and fed
into a large language model to generate correspond-
ing responses.

extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

retrieval.question: 比较《How to choose a suitable method in image semantic segmentation-An Experimental Study》和《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》：两篇选型研究的实际实验数据、评价指标与基准建议有什么区别？为什么不能把前者的Top-K数值当成后者语义分割mIoU的直接替代？
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Experimental Study虽讨论语义分割选型，但实际实验明确使用ILSVRC2012和Top-K类别准确率，比较六种CNN方法，多次运行取平均；该Top-K不是像素级分割质量。CVPRW研究分割微调、设置对排名和时间的影响，推荐ViT-B、16×16块、线性解码器及端到端微调，并采用多数据集，因为数据集和域偏移会影响排名；分割以预测/真值掩膜的mIoU评价。需区分实验口径，不可混用指标或直接比较数值判优。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The data sets used in this paper are the one used in
ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012
(ILSVRC2012).Top-K accuracy rate is used as an
evaluation index,

Based on the data sets, experiments were conducted on all 6
methods, with each method running 5 times, and the average
of the experimental results was taken as the final result.

The
results lead to a recommended benchmarking setup of fine-
tuning the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a16×16 patch size
and a linear decoder. Leveraging multiple datasets for train-
ing and evaluation is also recommended, as the performance
ranking across datasets and domain shifts varies. Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

Following common practice, the mean intersection over
union (mIoU) is used as the evaluation metric for seman-
tic segmentation, which measures the overlap between pre-
dicted and ground truth masks.

methods, with each method running 5 times, and the average
of the experimental results was taken as the final result.

results lead to a recommended benchmarking setup of fine-

probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of

tic segmentation, which measures the overlap between pre-
dicted and ground truth masks.

gold_evidence.evidence:
This paper investigates whether a promptable segmentation founda‑
tion model can monitor water surfaces and waterlogging zero‑shot—without any task‑
specific training or labeling—across the full illumination–weather spectrum of real surveil‑
lance operations.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

Recent vision foundation models (VFMs) have demon-
strated proficiency in various tasks but require supervised
fine-tuning to perform the task of semantic segmentation ef-
fectively.

Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

retrieval.question: 比较《Vision-Guided Cone Manipulation with Collaborative Robotic Arm》和《Multi-View Semantic–Geometric Perception for Post-Disaster Flexible Suction with Metric 3D Scene Reconstruction》：视觉感知如何接入机器人任务？两者在位置/尺度处理、动作选择和执行反馈方面分别提供了什么机制？
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：路锥系统在ROS2中使用YOLO位置、多次测量均值与初始/目标上方/必要时中间观察位姿改善定位，抓取前后负载差用于验证，失败可重试。抽吸方案用YOLO-LiteSeg和VGGT构建米制三维语义场景，以物理深度及障碍净空选择抽吸点。路锥研究含抓取反馈闭环，抽吸研究给出满足预设约束的选点参考；不能把感知/选点验证扩大为已完成完整灾后自主作业验证。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The system operates within a ROS2-based frame-
work and utilizes object position data provided by a YOLO-based vision subsystem. To
improve localization accuracy, multiple measurements are collected and averaged before
grasp planning. The grasping sequence is executed through predefined observation poses,
including an initial detection position and a secondary pose above the target. When the
cone is detected outside the optimal observation region, an additional intermediate obser-
vation pose is generated to further reduce localization errors.

Grasp reliability is enhanced
through a weight-based validation method utilizing the collaborative robot’s built-in force
sensing capability. The measured load before and after grasping is compared, and unsuc-
cessful grasps automatically trigger up to three retry attempts.

YOLO-LiteSeg provides obstacle instance masks, while 
Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) provides depth and camera parameters 
for multi-view reconstruction; checkerboard-based metric alignment converts reconstruc-
tion to physical scale. Projection-based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer produces an ob-
stacle-highlighted metric 3D scene representation for constraint-based suction-point se-
lection.

The resulting 3D representation generated suction-point references satisfying 
predeﬁned suction-depth and obstacle-clearance criteria, providing metrically interpreta-
ble spatial information for post-disaster ﬂexible suction.

cone is detected outside the optimal observation region, an additional intermediate obser-
vation pose is generated to further reduce localization errors.

sensing capability. The measured load before and after grasping is compared, and unsuc-
cessful grasps automatically trigger up to three retry attempts.

stacle-highlighted metric 3D scene representation for constraint-based suction-point se-
lection.

predeﬁned suction-depth and obstacle-clearance criteria, providing metrically interpreta-

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：香云纱研究分训练、验证、独立留出测试集，模型开发仅用训练/验证，按三个预定义种子的验证结果选架构，再报告对应独立训练的留出测试均值与标准差。SBRF-Det采用共同协议和固定留出队列，对A0–A2用三个独立种子，并进行成对影像级bootstrap差异分析。共同点是保留最终评价、检查稳定性；区别在选型过程与统计方法。数据和对象不同，mAP数值不能直接比较方法优劣。

gold_evidence.evidence:
In the revised experimental protocol, the
dataset was divided into 1400 training, 331 validation, and 100 held‑out test images, with
all model development experiments conducted using only the training and validation sub‑
sets. We compared a conventional five‑class taxonomy with a task‑oriented binary scheme
and evaluated multiple YOLO26 model scales, architectural modifications, and two repre‑
sentative lightweight YOLO detectors. Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

Across the three independently trained runs corresponding to seeds
0, 42, and 123, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv achieved a mean held‑out test mAP@0.5 of
46.1 ± 1.8%, compared with 39.8 ± 4.7% for the YOLO26s baseline.

The method was
evaluated on OralXrays-9, comprising 12,688 panoramic radiographs and 84,099 retained
annotations across nine categories, using a fixed 2688-image hold-out cohort. Twenty-two
detector configurations were compared under a common protocol, and A0–A2 were further
assessed using three independent seeds and paired radiograph-level bootstrap analysis.
