retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：牙齿框架在同一牙科X光的分割牙区上，以DenseNet201、MobileNet、ShuffleNetV2提取互补深度特征并融合，由BCO调参的KELM进行牙类分类，互补性来自不同特征提取模型。热感知方法从可见光与红外两种输入提取结构纹理和热响应，融合共享/模态特有信息并进行热感知门控，融合图像用于YOLO缺陷检测，互补性来自传感模态。多模型特征融合不能说成红外—可见光双模态融合。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

When the
fused images are evaluated using a unified YOLO-based detector, the proposed thermal-
aware fusion framework achieves precision, recall, and mAP at IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936,
0.921, and 0.943, respectively.

retrieval.reference_answer: 研究问题是增加网络深度时出现训练准确率退化，且该退化不只是过拟合。方法把目标映射H(x)改写为F(x)+x，让堆叠层学习F(x)=H(x)-x，并用恒等捷径连接相加。ImageNet和CIFAR-10实验表明残差网络更容易优化，增加深度可以带来准确率收益；论文的152层ImageNet模型复杂度仍低于VGG，残差网络集成取得3.57%的top-5测试错误率。

We show that: 1) Our extremely deep residual nets
are easy to optimize, but the counterpart “plain” nets (that
simply stack layers) exhibit higher training error when the
depth increases; 2) Our deep residual nets can easily enjoy
accuracy gains from greatly increased depth, producing re-
sults substantially better than previous networks.

Our 152-
layer residual net is the deepest network ever presented on
ImageNet, while still having lower complexity than VGG
nets [40]. Our ensemble has 3.57% top-5 error on the
ImageNet test set, and won the 1st place in the ILSVRC
2015 classiﬁcation competition .

retrieval.reference_answer: 论文针对把Mamba用于视觉时的单向建模和位置感知不足，提出Vim：图像切patch并线性投影，加入位置嵌入，用双向选择性状态空间块进行依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模。先在ImageNet监督图像分类上训练，再将骨干用于语义分割、目标检测和实例分割。状态空间计算随序列长度线性增长，与全局自注意力的二次增长形成效率差异；论文报告的优势应限定在其任务、模型和实验设置内。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

We first
split the input image into patches and linearly project them
as vectors to Vim. Image patches are treated as the sequence
data in Vim blocks, which efficiently compresses the vi-
sual representation with the proposed bidirectional selective
state space.

In
the current stage, we train the Vim model on the supervised
image classification task using the ImageNet dataset and
then use the pretrained Vim as the backbone to perform
sequential visual representation learning for downstream
dense prediction tasks, i.e., semantic segmentation, object
detection, and instance segmentation.

where self-attention is quadratic to sequence length M, and
SSM is linear to sequence length M (N is a fixed parameter,
set to 16 by default).

Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

We dynami-
cally conduct joint training on images and videos,
wherein a single batch contains both image and
video samples simultaneously.

The training objective of this
stage is the original auto-regressive loss, where the
model learns the basic ability to view the vision.
We freeze the other parameters of the model during
this process.

In this stage, the model is required to provide
responses corresponding to different instructions.
These instructions often involve more complex
visual comprehension tasks, rather than just de-
scribing visual signals.

After this stage, the model learns to generate
corresponding responses based on different instruc-
tions and requests. The LLM are also involved in
training at this stage.

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》推荐的评测配置、数据集使用方式和不推荐的做法。
retrieval.reference_answer: 论文研究如何兼顾排名代表性与训练效率。推荐使用ViT-B、16×16 patch、线性解码器进行端到端微调；这组配置相对于更大模型、更强解码器和更小patch的配置，能够大幅减少训练时间并具有一定排名代表性。建议使用多个数据集进行训练和评估，因为数据集和域偏移会改变模型排名。论文不推荐仅做线性探测，因为冻结编码器得到的排名不能代表端到端微调。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Based on the results, the recommendation is to fine-
tune the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a 16 × 16 patch size
and a linear decoder, as these settings are representative of
using a larger model, more advanced decoder and smaller
patch size, while reducing training time by more than 13
times.

Leveraging multiple datasets for train-
ing and evaluation is also recommended, as the performance
ranking across datasets and domain shifts varies. Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《How to choose a suitable method in image semantic segmentation-An Experimental Study》实际比较的六种方法、实验数据与评价指标、主要结果。
retrieval.reference_answer: 实际比较DenseNet201、EfficientNetB7、InceptionV3、ResNet152V2、InceptionResNetV2和VGG16。第4节使用ILSVRC2012数据，以Top-K准确率评估，每种方法运行5次取平均。结果是EfficientNetB7在Top1最好，ResNet152V2在Top2、Top3最好；这两种方法的Top3均超过0.8。尽管题名讨论语义分割，文中该实验报告的是图像类别Top-K指标，不能把它直接当作像素级分割mIoU。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The data sets used in this paper are the one used in
ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012
(ILSVRC2012).Top-K accuracy rate is used as an
evaluation index

specifically six methods including
DenseNet201, EfficientNetB7, InceptionResNetV2,
InceptionV3, ResNet152V2 and VGG16.

Based on the data sets, experiments were conducted on all 6
methods, with each method running 5 times, and the average
of the experimental results was taken as the final result.

As shown in the figure, EfficientNetB7 performs best in
Top1 accuracy, but is surpassed by ResNet152V2 in Top2
and Top3 accuracies. Although DenseNet201 has lower
accuracy in Top 1 compared to other methods, its
performance on Top2 and Top 3 is similar to those of
InceptionV3 and VGG16. In summary, EfficientNetB7 and
ResNet152V2 perform well, the Top3 accuracy both
exceeding 0.8

retrieval.reference_answer: TSCFFM-AOABI先用Blur、MedianBlur、ToGray和CLAHE增强图像，再用Adam训练的YOLO11s分割牙齿实例。DenseNet201、MobileNet和ShuffleNetV2提取分割区域的互补特征并融合，由KELM分类，BCO优化KELM惩罚参数C和RBF核参数γ。论文使用包含598张牙科X光图像与32类牙齿的基准集，报告准确率96.17%、精确率95.10%、召回率99.03%和F1 98.00%；这些是该数据集实验报告，不能直接等同于临床部署效果。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Methods: The proposed frame work first 
applies image augmentation using Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and Contrast -Limited 
Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to improve image variability and feature vis-
ibility. Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer.

The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

Results: The proposed framework is evaluated on a benchmark dental X-ray image 
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes. Experimental results demonstrate an 
accuracy of 96.17%, precision of 95.10%, recall of 99.03%, and an F1-score of 98.00%.

retrieval.reference_answer: TSCFFM-AOABI先用Blur、MedianBlur、ToGray和CLAHE增强图像，再用Adam训练的YOLO11s分割牙齿实例。DenseNet201、MobileNet和ShuffleNetV2提取分割区域的互补特征并融合，由KELM分类，BCO优化KELM惩罚参数C和RBF核参数γ。论文使用包含598张牙科X光图像与32类牙齿的基准集，报告准确率96.17%、精确率95.10%、召回率99.03%和F1 98.00%；这些是该数据集实验报告，不能直接等同于临床部署效果。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Methods: The proposed frame work first 
applies image augmentation using Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and Contrast -Limited 
Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to improve image variability and feature vis-
ibility. Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the 
Adam optimizer.

The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

Results: The proposed framework is evaluated on a benchmark dental X-ray image 
dataset containing 598 images and 32 tooth classes. Experimental results demonstrate an 
accuracy of 96.17%, precision of 95.10%, recall of 99.03%, and an F1-score of 98.00%.

retrieval.reference_answer: 交通锥抓取工作利用YOLO和双目视觉估计位置，通过50次观测平均和多阶段观测提高抓取坐标准确性，再结合机械臂的载荷变化验证抓取。西瓜工作利用YOLO11-OBB进行旋转目标定位，把定向边界框转换为椭圆几何先验，指导AISGAN完成被遮挡部分的非模态重建，并通过双椭圆等后处理得到更完整的形状用于尺寸估计。共同点是视觉模型之后均加入与任务有关的几何或验证环节，不能只凭原始检测输出完成下游任务。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The vision subsystem combines deep-learning-based
object detection with stereo vision to estimate traffic cone positions relative to the camera
coordinate system.

For this the cone collector program collects 50 consecutive measurements and calcu-
lates their average. The experiment results showed that this number is a balance between
fast execution and high accuracy.

The combination of point averaging and multi-stage observation provides sufficient
positioning accuracy for reliable cone grasping.

The system utilizes the collaborative features
of the robot arm by measuring the load applied to the end-effector before and after the
grasping operation, allowing automatic validation of a successful cone grasp.

YOLO11-OBB is used to provide rotation-aware localization for inference in this study.
The oriented bounding boxes are converted into ellipse-based geometric priors that guide
AISGAN amodal reconstruction and improve robustness under arbitrary fruit orientation.

This dual-ellipse strategy is
used to enhance robustness under asymmetric occlusion by capturing alternative boundary
interpretations and reducing underestimation. Figure 5c shows this process, where two
ellipses are generated from different minor-axis points and merged to form the final
reconstructed shape.

gold_evidence.evidence:
The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

Experiments are conducted on a spatially aligned infrared–visible dataset
containing normal insulator strings, normal strain clamps, damaged insulator strings,
insulator thermal faults, and strain clamp thermal faults.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

dataset comprising 1831 annotated images.

Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑
ity control system. This study demonstrates the feasibility of linking defect localization
with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

retrieval.question: 根据《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》，为什么不能仅根据ImageNet上从头训练的表现否定ViT？请结合归纳偏置和预训练规模的实验讨论。
retrieval.reference_answer: ViT缺少CNN的局部性和平移等变性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化会受到影响；这说明小数据训练结果依赖数据规模，不能直接否定该架构。论文在更大预训练集上看到更强结果：ViT-Large在ImageNet预训练下不如ViT-Base，ImageNet-21k下相近，JFT-300M下才显现大模型的完整收益。该结论限定于论文的模型与实验，不能推成任意数据规模下ViT都优于CNN。

gold_evidence.evidence:
inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well
when trained on insufﬁcient amounts of data.
However, the picture changes if the models are trained on larger datasets (14M-300M images). We
ﬁnd that large scale training trumps inductive bias.

When pre-trained on the
smallest dataset, ImageNet, ViT-Large models underperform compared to ViT-Base models, despite
(moderate) regularization. With ImageNet-21k pre-training, their performances are similar. Only
with JFT-300M, do we see the full beneﬁt of larger models.

retrieval.reference_answer: ViT缺少CNN的局部性和平移等变性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化会受到影响；这说明小数据训练结果依赖数据规模，不能直接否定该架构。论文在更大预训练集上看到更强结果：ViT-Large在ImageNet预训练下不如ViT-Base，ImageNet-21k下相近，JFT-300M下才显现大模型的完整收益。该结论限定于论文的模型与实验，不能推成任意数据规模下ViT都优于CNN。

retrieval.question: 论文《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》为什么同时引入双向SSM和位置嵌入？它们分别处理什么问题？
retrieval.reference_answer: 论文将原始Mamba用于视觉的困难概括为单向建模和缺乏位置感知。双向SSM用于依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模；位置嵌入为视觉识别提供位置信息，在密集预测中体现空间感知。它们是不同问题的对应设计，不能把双向性理解为代替位置信息。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

Furthermore, the position embedding in Vim
block provides the awareness for spatial information, which
enables Vim to be more robust in dense prediction tasks.

retrieval.question: 根据《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》，为什么线性探测更省训练资源却仍不被推荐作为端到端微调的替代评测？
retrieval.reference_answer: 冻结编码器会改变不同VFM的表现与排名，论文得到的排名相关系数仅0.38。因此线性探测虽然减少训练成本，却不足以代表端到端微调的结果；作者建议使用端到端微调来获得有代表性的比较。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Current VFMs
may not acquire enough spatial semantic understanding in
pretraining to perform semantic segmentation effectively
without end-to-end fine-tuning. Furthermore, a low correla-
tion coefficient of 0.38 suggests freezing the encoder signif-
icantly changes the performance ranking. Therefore, even
though linear probing is efficient, end-to-end fine-tuning is

retrieval.reference_answer: 冻结编码器会改变不同VFM的表现与排名，论文得到的排名相关系数仅0.38。因此线性探测虽然减少训练成本，却不足以代表端到端微调的结果；作者建议使用端到端微调来获得有代表性的比较。

gold_evidence.evidence:

pretraining to perform semantic segmentation effectively

recommended for a representative benchmark.

retrieval.question: 根据《SBRF-Det: Scale-Boundary Representative Fusion for Multi-Finding Detection in Panoramic Dental Radiographs》，为什么边界相关局部信息对mAP50-95比仅正确分类更关键？请结合正文中的局部与全局融合解释。
retrieval.reference_answer: mAP50-95要求在逐渐严格的IoU阈值下仍有准确边界框重叠，正确类别本身不足以获得较高指标。局部信息保留病灶边缘、修复体界面、牙根等结构线索，可以影响框几何；全局上下文帮助区分外观相似而解剖位置不同的发现。边界门控对局部分支增强调节更强、对全局分支仅适度衰减，以兼顾边界定位与语义上下文。

gold_evidence.evidence:
A strong boundary response increases
the local contribution while only moderately attenuating the global branch.

Global context
helps distinguish visually similar structures that occur in different anatomical settings,
while local evidence is retained around lesion margins, restoration interfaces, root struc-
tures, and other high-frequency regions. The P4 placement further preserves a spatial
resolution at which these cues can influence box geometry. This design is particularly
relevant to mAP50-95, where correct class prediction alone is insufficient and bounding-box
overlap must remain accurate across progressively stricter IoU thresholds.

retrieval.question: 根据《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》，为什么可见光与红外需要互补融合，而简单平均仍有局限？
retrieval.reference_answer: 可见光提供轮廓、纹理与结构异常，但受光照、背景和遮挡影响；红外能揭示异常发热，却缺少丰富纹理且结构边界模糊。简单平均能加入两种信息，但平等对待所有模态和位置，不考虑模态特性、空间重要性与热响应分布。论文因此采用热感知门控和共享/专属特征交互；在该文同协议检测对比中，提出方法的mAP@0.5:0.95为0.657，简单平均为0.597，不能把该结果外推到所有融合任务。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Visible images provide rich appear-
ance, contour, and texture information and are therefore suitable for identifying structural
abnormalities such as damage, cracks, deformation, and foreign object attachment. Infrared
images provide complementary thermal response information and are particularly use-
ful for revealing abnormal heating associated with poor contact, insulation degradation,
and other thermally related faults. However, visible images are sensitive to illumination,
background interference, and occlusion, whereas infrared images generally provide limited
texture details and relatively blurred structural boundaries [4].

However, simple averaging treats visible and infrared information equally and does
not consider modality-specific characteristics, spatial importance, or thermal response
distribution. The proposed fused representation achieves precision, recall, and mAP at
IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936, 0.921, and 0.943, respectively. Compared with simple average
fusion, the proposed framework improves mAP at IoU = 0.5:0.95 from 0.597 to 0.657,
corresponding to an absolute improvement of 0.060.

retrieval.reference_answer: 测试集只在最终结构选择后用于最终评估，训练集用于优化，验证集用于模型规模比较、消融和选择，从而避免把模型开发用过的数据当作独立最终评测。修订协议下从头训练且不继承旧实验的权重、检查点、优化器状态或其他学习状态，避免旧实验状态影响新划分。作者明确说该协议分离开发与保留集评估，并降低把验证表现报告成最终模型表现的评价偏差。

retrieval.question: 根据《Multi-View Semantic–Geometric Perception for Post-Disaster Flexible Suction with Metric 3D Scene Reconstruction》，为什么仅有2D实例掩码或未对齐物理尺度的3D重建不足以支持吸取点选择？
retrieval.reference_answer: 2D掩码提供障碍物语义，但不能直接给出物理高度、坡度或障碍物间距。吸取深度、沉积厚度、距离等是有单位的量，未定尺度的重建不能直接应用这些约束。论文将YOLO-LiteSeg语义与VGGT几何结合，用棋盘格对齐到物理尺度并将2D标签转到3D点云，在吸取深度和最大化最小障碍物间距准则下生成参考点。

gold_evidence.evidence:
image-plane masks alone 
cannot provide physical height, surface slope, or obstacle clearance, while geometry with-
out semantics cannot distinguish obstacle regions from obstacle-free sludge regions.

For ﬂexible suction, the reconstructed geometry must addi-
tionally be converted to physical scale because sludge-deposit thickness, height proﬁles, 
obstacle distances, and suction depth are metric quantities rather than scale-ambiguous 
geometric descriptors.

Finally, semantic labels from 
the  2D  obstacle  instance  masks  are  transferred  to  the  corresponding  reconstructed  3D 
points,  and  the  resulting metric  3D  scene  representation  integrating  obstacle  semantics 
and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.

gold_evidence.evidence: To do so, we split an image into patches and provide the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Trans- former. retrieval.question: 《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》在 1248×1248 图像的批量特征提取实验中，相对 DeiT 的速度和 GPU 显存结果是什么？
retrieval.reference_answer: Vim的速度为DeiT的2.8倍，并节省86.8% GPU显存；该结果限定为1248×1248图像的批量推理特征提取场景。

gold_evidence.evidence: Specifically, Vim is 2.8× faster than DeiT and saves 86.8% GPU memory when performing batch inference to extract features on images at the resolution of 1248×1248.

retrieval.question: 《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》推荐用哪种模型规模、patch 大小和解码器进行基准测试？摘要报告训练时间减少多少倍？
retrieval.reference_answer: 推荐对VFM的ViT-B版本进行微调，采用16×16 patch和线性解码器。摘要称该设置能代表更大模型、更复杂解码器和更小patch的排序，同时将训练时间减少超过13倍。

gold_evidence.evidence: the recommendation is to fine- tune the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a 16 × 16 patch size and a linear decoder, as these settings are representative of using a larger model, more advanced decoder and smaller patch size, while reducing training time by more than 13 times.

retrieval.reference_answer: 参数量从27.24 M降至2.61 M；GFLOPs从52.37降至5.47；推理时间为4.56 ms。这些结果来自九种模拟条件。

gold_evidence.evidence: Across nine simulated conditions, YOLO-LiteSeg reduced parameters from 27.24 M to 2.61 M and giga floating-point operations from 52.37 to 5.47, while achieving 99.02% mean average precision at 0.50 intersection over union and 84.36% across thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, with 4.56 ms inference.

3. Experimental Protocol and Dataset
3.1. Experimental Setup
To evaluate the proposed multi-view semantic-geometric perception framework un-
der controlled conditions, we built a laboratory platform representing the near-field work-
space of post-disaster flexible suction. The platform reproduces a simulated post-disaster
sludge workspace containing stones and shrubs as representative obstacles. The dataset
consists of multi-view RGB image sequences acquired by RGB-D cameras mounted on a
small multi-link arm configured to emulate the observation setup of an emergency exca-
vator. These cameras were used for image acquisition, but only their RGB streams were
used as perception inputs; the depth streams were not used as model inputs. The rectan-
gular steel platform measured 1 m × 0.5 m × 0.08 m. A three-link arm system was fixed to

one side. Bentonite mixed with water was used to simulate sludge. Qinglong stones and
biomimetic shrubs were used to simulate stone and shrub obstacles and were arranged
according to the required obstacle coverage level and size. During data collection, the
multi-link arm moved along a preset observation path. The arm-mounted cameras syn-
chronously collected continuous RGB image sequences. This process represents a pre-op-
eration visual inspection stage in which multi-view observations of sludge deposits and
obstacles are acquired before flexible suction. Figure 4 shows the platform structure.

Abstract
Background/Objectives: Dental health is an important component of overall well-being,
and accurate tooth analysis supports several applications in dental imaging. Tooth seg-
mentation is a crucial stage in digital dental workflows, particularly for orthodontic diag-
nosis, treatment planning, and the assessment of treatment-related changes such as root

resorption. However, the complex anatomical structures and variations present in dental
X-ray images make accurate tooth segmentation and classification challenging. To address
these challenges, this study develops a Tooth Segmentation and Classification through the
Fusion of Feature Extraction Models and Advanced Optimization Algorithms Using Bio-
medical Images (TSCFFM-AOABI) framework. Methods: The proposed framework first
applies image augmentation using Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and Contrast-Limited
Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) to improve image variability and feature vis-
ibility. Tooth instances are subsequently segmented using YOLO11s trained with the
Adam optimizer. The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201,
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations,
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-

Oral 2026, 6, 131 2 of 19
recognition, particularly under the serious conditions typically encountered in mass dis-
asters, where dental features are among the few biometric identifiers that are suitable for
PM identification [1]. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based image analysis has increasingly
been explored in dentistry to support dental professionals in interpreting medical images
and identifying relevant anatomical structures [2]. Such computational approaches can
assist dental professionals by reducing repetitive image analysis tasks and providing
quantitative information for subsequent clinical assessment. However, these systems are
intended to function as supportive tools and do not replace professional clinical judgment.
Pre-surgery simulation methods have been applied to processes like quantitative estima-
tion and tooth rearrangement in three-dimensional (3D) tooth movement [3]. Tooth seg-
mentation is a significant stage in multiple automated and semi-automated computer-
based methods.

main contributions of this study are summarized as follows:
• Develop a unified TSCFFM-AOABI framework for tooth instance segmentation and
tooth-level classification from dental X-ray images. The framework separates the seg-
mentation and classification stages, allowing YOLO11s to perform tooth instance seg-
mentation and a dedicated KELM classifier to perform tooth-level classification. This
https://doi.org/10.3390/oral6050131

tal image segmentation, most approaches primarily focus on a single segmentation archi-
tecture or a specific feature-learning strategy. The integration of instance-level tooth seg-
mentation with complementary multi-backbone feature representation and optimized
kernel-based classification remains relatively underexplored for dental X-ray analysis. To
address this gap, the proposed TSCFFM-AOABI framework establishes a sequential ar-
chitecture in which YOLO11s first separates individual tooth instances, DenseNet201, Mo-
bileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 subsequently learn complementary representations from the
segmented regions, and feature fusion provides a unified representation for KELM-based
classification. Thus, the novelty of the framework lies not in introducing new versions of
the individual algorithms, but in their task-specific integration into a unified segmenta-
tion–feature fusion–classification framework with optimization-guided classification. The

The dataset comprised nine controlled experimental conditions covering four factors:

(3) How can detection results support the creative reuse of defective fabric rather than

Accordingly,thisstudymakesfourmaincontributions. First,itconstructsandpub‑

els—shallow (15 cm), medium (25 cm), and deep (35 cm)—to represent controlled varia-
tions in deposit thickness. Camera configuration was set by field-of-view coverage and
redundancy: the basic configuration used one end-mounted camera observation position,
the enhanced configuration used three camera observation positions, and the redundant
configuration used five camera observation positions. Stone and Shrub projected-area
coverage ratios were used to characterize class-specific image-plane obstacle occupancy
and visual interference in perception. For both Stone and Shrub obstacles, low, medium,
and high projected-area coverage levels corresponded to projected coverage ratios below
10%, 10–25%, and above 25%, respectively. An L9(34) orthogonal array was used to gen-

3.3.2. MobileNet Model
The MobileNet technique is employed, which was trained on the ImageNet dataset.
The size of an input image is fixed at 640*640. The MobileNet structure consists of 28 layers
and uses 3 × 3 depth-wise and 1 × 1 point-wise convolutions [23]. Depth-wise convolution
applies a separate filter to each input channel, while point-wise convolution combines
these outputs to generate new feature maps. This design reduces computational cost while
maintaining useful feature representations. To enhance the performance of the model, the
activation functions of batch normalization (BN) and ReLU are employed successively
after every depth-wise and point-wise convolution, which aid in altering the parameters
of the network, avoiding vanishing gradients, and accelerating training.

retrieval.question: 《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》的实验协议规定 ADE20K、PASCAL VOC、Cityscapes、GTA V 各训练多少步？有效 batch size 和随机种子重复次数是多少？
retrieval.reference_answer: ADE20K训练40,000步；PASCAL VOC、Cityscapes和GTA V各20,000步。实际batch size=1，通过梯度累积将有效batch size提至16；每个实验使用不同随机种子重复3次，报告均值与标准差。

gold_evidence.evidence: The batch size is set to 1 to make training more accessible by reducing the mem- ory requirements. Through gradient accumulation the effec- tive batch size is increased to 16 to align with Mask2Former. The number of training steps is set to 40,000 for ADE20K, and 20,000 for PASCAL VOC, Cityscapes and GTA V . Ex- periments are repeated thrice with different random seeds, and the average performance is reported along with the standard deviation.

retrieval.question: 《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》的实验协议规定 ADE20K、PASCAL VOC、Cityscapes、GTA V 各训练多少步？有效 batch size 和随机种子重复次数是多少？
retrieval.reference_answer: ADE20K训练40,000步；PASCAL VOC、Cityscapes和GTA V各20,000步。实际batch size=1，通过梯度累积将有效batch size提至16；每个实验使用不同随机种子重复3次，报告均值与标准差。

gold_evidence.evidence: The batch size is set to 1 to make training more accessible by reducing the mem- ory requirements. Through gradient accumulation the effec- tive batch size is increased to 16 to align with Mask2Former. The number of training steps is set to 40,000 for ADE20K, and 20,000 for PASCAL VOC, Cityscapes and GTA V . Ex- periments are repeated thrice with different random seeds, and the average performance is reported along with the standard deviation.

retrieval.question: 比较《Attention Is All You Need》和《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》：两篇论文如何把输入组织成序列，输出任务有何不同？请区分语言序列与图像块序列，并说明共同的注意力架构思路。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Transformer用于序列转换，以编码器—解码器和注意力处理输入、输出序列，原论文主要验证机器翻译。ViT将图像切为固定大小的块，进行线性嵌入、加位置嵌入后送入标准Transformer编码器，额外可学习分类token用于图像分类。二者共享序列表示和注意力思路，输入单元及输出任务不同，不能把ViT说成翻译解码器。

gold_evidence.evidence:
We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer,
based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions
entirely.

Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to
be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly
less time to train.
Most competitive neural sequence transduction models have an encoder-decoder structure [5, 2, 35].

Model overview. We split an image into ﬁxed-size patches, linearly embed each of them,
add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer
encoder. In order to perform classiﬁcation, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable
“classiﬁcation token” to the sequence.

ciently emphasizes relevant features, highlights important features, and improves feature
representation in complex image regions.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：ResNet以F(x)=H(x)-x重写残差映射，通过恒等shortcut将输入加到残差输出上，缓解更深网络的优化/退化问题。ViT的图像特定归纳偏置少于CNN；CNN内置局部性、二维邻域和平移等变性，而ViT更多从数据中学习空间关系，通常在大数据集预训练后迁移到较小下游任务。不能据此声称ResNet完全不需要训练数据，也不能脱离训练规模直接判定架构普遍优劣。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Formally, denoting the desired
underlying mapping as H(x), we let the stacked nonlinear
layers ﬁt another mapping of F(x): = H(x) − x. The orig-
inal mapping is recast into F(x)+ x.

In our case, the shortcut connections simply
perform identity mapping, and their outputs are added to
the outputs of the stacked layers (Fig. 2).

We note that Vision Transformer has much less image-speciﬁc inductive bias than
CNNs. In CNNs, locality, two-dimensional neighborhood structure, and translation equivariance are
baked into each layer throughout the whole model.
Typically, we pre-train ViT on large datasets, and ﬁne-tune to (smaller) downstream tasks.

retrieval.question: 比较《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》和《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》：它们融合哪些输入信息、在哪一层完成对齐或交互、最终输出用于什么任务？请区分统一视觉—语言表征与红外—可见光图像融合。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Video-LLaVA用LanguageBind图像/视频编码器先对齐到共享语言特征空间，再使用共享投影层，把视觉表示和文本查询送入LLM生成语言回答。热感知方法用可见光和红外双分支分别提取结构纹理与热响应，以共享—特有表征及交互融合互补信息，以热感知门控强化热异常并保留结构，输出融合图像用于输电设备缺陷检测。二者输入模态、对齐空间及下游输出不同。

gold_evidence.evidence:
By shar-
ing a language feature space, the image and video
representations ultimately converge into a unified
visual feature space, which we refer to as emergent
alignment of images and videos. Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

Subsequently, the unified visual representation is
encoded by shared projection layers, which is then
combined with tokenized textual queries and fed
into a large language model to generate correspond-
ing responses.

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

retrieval.question: 比较《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》和《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》：它们融合哪些输入信息、在哪一层完成对齐或交互、最终输出用于什么任务？请区分统一视觉—语言表征与红外—可见光图像融合。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Video-LLaVA用LanguageBind图像/视频编码器先对齐到共享语言特征空间，再使用共享投影层，把视觉表示和文本查询送入LLM生成语言回答。热感知方法用可见光和红外双分支分别提取结构纹理与热响应，以共享—特有表征及交互融合互补信息，以热感知门控强化热异常并保留结构，输出融合图像用于输电设备缺陷检测。二者输入模态、对齐空间及下游输出不同。

gold_evidence.evidence:
By shar-
ing a language feature space, the image and video
representations ultimately converge into a unified
visual feature space, which we refer to as emergent
alignment of images and videos. Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

Subsequently, the unified visual representation is
encoded by shared projection layers, which is then
combined with tokenized textual queries and fed
into a large language model to generate correspond-
ing responses.

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

retrieval.question: 比较《How to choose a suitable method in image semantic segmentation-An Experimental Study》和《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》：两篇选型研究的实际实验数据、评价指标与基准建议有什么区别？为什么不能把前者的Top-K数值当成后者语义分割mIoU的直接替代？
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：Experimental Study虽讨论语义分割选型，但实际实验明确使用ILSVRC2012和Top-K类别准确率，比较六种CNN方法，多次运行取平均；该Top-K不是像素级分割质量。CVPRW研究分割微调、设置对排名和时间的影响，推荐ViT-B、16×16块、线性解码器及端到端微调，并采用多数据集，因为数据集和域偏移会影响排名；分割以预测/真值掩膜的mIoU评价。需区分实验口径，不可混用指标或直接比较数值判优。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The data sets used in this paper are the one used in
ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012
(ILSVRC2012).Top-K accuracy rate is used as an
evaluation index,

Based on the data sets, experiments were conducted on all 6
methods, with each method running 5 times, and the average
of the experimental results was taken as the final result.

The
results lead to a recommended benchmarking setup of fine-
tuning the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a16×16 patch size
and a linear decoder. Leveraging multiple datasets for train-
ing and evaluation is also recommended, as the performance
ranking across datasets and domain shifts varies. Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

Following common practice, the mean intersection over
union (mIoU) is used as the evaluation metric for seman-
tic segmentation, which measures the overlap between pre-
dicted and ground truth masks.

ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012
(ILSVRC2012).Top-K accuracy rate is used as an
evaluation index,

Based on the data sets, experiments were conducted on all 6
methods, with each method running 5 times, and the average
of the experimental results was taken as the final result.

The
results lead to a recommended benchmarking setup of fine-
tuning the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a16×16 patch size
and a linear decoder. Leveraging multiple datasets for train-
ing and evaluation is also recommended, as the performance
ranking across datasets and domain shifts varies. Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

union (mIoU) is used as the evaluation metric for seman-
tic segmentation, which measures the overlap between pre-
dicted and ground truth masks.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：水面监测用已有SAM 3及water提示做零样本分割，不做任务特定训练/标注来适配模型，提取水面积和水线指标，评价昼夜/雨情稳定性、事件检测、负样本误报及与专家掩膜的一致性。CVPRW基准考察VFM的语义分割监督微调，强调端到端微调的代表性，不推荐以线性探测替代它。特定水面场景零样本有效不表示通用多类分割无需微调；专家参考掩膜用于评价也不等于用于训练模型。

gold_evidence.evidence:
This paper investigates whether a promptable segmentation founda‑
tion model can monitor water surfaces and waterlogging zero‑shot—without any task‑
specific training or labeling—across the full illumination–weather spectrum of real surveil‑
lance operations.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

Recent vision foundation models (VFMs) have demon-
strated proficiency in various tasks but require supervised
fine-tuning to perform the task of semantic segmentation ef-
fectively.

Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：水面监测用已有SAM 3及water提示做零样本分割，不做任务特定训练/标注来适配模型，提取水面积和水线指标，评价昼夜/雨情稳定性、事件检测、负样本误报及与专家掩膜的一致性。CVPRW基准考察VFM的语义分割监督微调，强调端到端微调的代表性，不推荐以线性探测替代它。特定水面场景零样本有效不表示通用多类分割无需微调；专家参考掩膜用于评价也不等于用于训练模型。

gold_evidence.evidence:
This paper investigates whether a promptable segmentation founda‑
tion model can monitor water surfaces and waterlogging zero‑shot—without any task‑
specific training or labeling—across the full illumination–weather spectrum of real surveil‑
lance operations.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

Recent vision foundation models (VFMs) have demon-
strated proficiency in various tasks but require supervised
fine-tuning to perform the task of semantic segmentation ef-
fectively.

Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

Abstract
Post-disaster flexible suction requires perception of obstacle semantics and metric 3D ge-
ometry in cluttered, partially occluded workspaces. However, image-plane masks alone
cannot provide physical height, surface slope, or obstacle clearance, while geometry with-
out semantics cannot distinguish obstacle regions from obstacle-free sludge regions. This
study proposes a multi-view semantic-geometric perception framework using synchro-
nized arm-mounted RGB images. YOLO-LiteSeg provides obstacle instance masks, while
Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) provides depth and camera parameters
for multi-view reconstruction; checkerboard-based metric alignment converts reconstruc-

mary objective remains a metric 3D scene representation in which obstacle semantics and
reconstructed sludge geometry can be jointly interpreted for suction-point selection.
Despite the above progress, the most closely related studies generally focus on se-
mantic mapping, urban or aerial reconstruction, robot navigation, point-cloud interpreta-
tion, or construction-site measurement [4,7–18,22–25]. Post-disaster flexible suction im-
poses a different combination of requirements: obstacle instance masks must remain com-
putationally efficient; sludge geometry must be recovered at metric scale from multi-view
RGB images; obstacle labels must be associated with the corresponding reconstructed 3D
points; camera-position estimates must remain spatially consistent with the reconstructed
scene; and the resulting semantic and geometric information must be converted into a
suction-point reference under predefined suction-depth and obstacle-clearance criteria.

verts synchronized multi-view RGB images into a metric 3D scene representation that in-
tegrates obstacle semantics with reconstructed sludge geometry and provides metrically
interpretable spatial information for post-disaster flexible suction under the tested con-
trolled conditions. Its current validation is limited to controlled simulations and criterion-
based evaluation with representative visualization of suction-point references; perfor-
mance in real disaster sites and during actual suction remains unverified. Future work
will examine real-site data, online multi-view scene updates, suction-process feedback,
and path planning to evaluate generalization and closed-loop deployment.

5. Conclusions
This study developed a multi-view semantic-geometric perception framework for
post-disaster flexible suction using synchronized multi-view RGB images acquired by
arm-mounted cameras, linking lightweight obstacle instance segmentation with metric 3D
scene reconstruction, projection-based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer, and constraint-
based suction-point selection. The resulting processing chain forms a metric 3D scene rep-
resentation integrating obstacle semantics and reconstructed geometry. Supporting cam-
era-position estimates were evaluated as an additional output of the multi-view recon-
struction module. The framework was evaluated under nine controlled simulated condi-
tions varying sludge-deposit thickness, camera configuration, Stone projected-area cover-
age ratio, and Shrub projected-area coverage ratio. An additional dual-peak scene was
used to qualitatively evaluate suction-point selection at three stages of manual sludge re-
moval.

tion to physical scale. Projection-based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer produces an ob-
stacle-highlighted metric 3D scene representation for constraint-based suction-point se-
lection. Across nine simulated conditions, YOLO-LiteSeg reduced parameters from 27.24
M to 2.61 M and giga floating-point operations from 52.37 to 5.47, while achieving 99.02%
mean average precision at 0.50 intersection over union and 84.36% across thresholds from
0.50 to 0.95, with 4.56 ms inference. Reconstructed steepest-slope height profiles showed
mean absolute errors below 2 cm. Enhanced and redundant camera configurations
yielded a mean projected camera-position error of 4.02 cm and a root mean square error
of 4.53 cm. The resulting 3D representation generated suction-point references satisfying
predefined suction-depth and obstacle-clearance criteria, providing metrically interpreta-
ble spatial information for post-disaster flexible suction.
Keywords: multi-view RGB images; semantic–geometric perception; obstacle instance

gold_evidence.evidence:
The system operates within a ROS2-based frame-
work and utilizes object position data provided by a YOLO-based vision subsystem. To
improve localization accuracy, multiple measurements are collected and averaged before
grasp planning. The grasping sequence is executed through predefined observation poses,
including an initial detection position and a secondary pose above the target. When the
cone is detected outside the optimal observation region, an additional intermediate obser-
vation pose is generated to further reduce localization errors.

Grasp reliability is enhanced
through a weight-based validation method utilizing the collaborative robot’s built-in force
sensing capability. The measured load before and after grasping is compared, and unsuc-
cessful grasps automatically trigger up to three retry attempts.

YOLO-LiteSeg provides obstacle instance masks, while 
Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) provides depth and camera parameters 
for multi-view reconstruction; checkerboard-based metric alignment converts reconstruc-
tion to physical scale. Projection-based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer produces an ob-
stacle-highlighted metric 3D scene representation for constraint-based suction-point se-
lection.

The resulting 3D representation generated suction-point references satisfying 
predeﬁned suction-depth and obstacle-clearance criteria, providing metrically interpreta-
ble spatial information for post-disaster ﬂexible suction.

gold_evidence.evidence:
In the revised experimental protocol, the
dataset was divided into 1400 training, 331 validation, and 100 held‑out test images, with
all model development experiments conducted using only the training and validation sub‑
sets. We compared a conventional five‑class taxonomy with a task‑oriented binary scheme
and evaluated multiple YOLO26 model scales, architectural modifications, and two repre‑
sentative lightweight YOLO detectors. Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

Across the three independently trained runs corresponding to seeds
0, 42, and 123, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv achieved a mean held‑out test mAP@0.5 of
46.1 ± 1.8%, compared with 39.8 ± 4.7% for the YOLO26s baseline.

The method was
evaluated on OralXrays-9, comprising 12,688 panoramic radiographs and 84,099 retained
annotations across nine categories, using a fixed 2688-image hold-out cohort. Twenty-two
detector configurations were compared under a common protocol, and A0–A2 were further
assessed using three independent seeds and paired radiograph-level bootstrap analysis.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：香云纱研究分训练、验证、独立留出测试集，模型开发仅用训练/验证，按三个预定义种子的验证结果选架构，再报告对应独立训练的留出测试均值与标准差。SBRF-Det采用共同协议和固定留出队列，对A0–A2用三个独立种子，并进行成对影像级bootstrap差异分析。共同点是保留最终评价、检查稳定性；区别在选型过程与统计方法。数据和对象不同，mAP数值不能直接比较方法优劣。

gold_evidence.evidence:
In the revised experimental protocol, the
dataset was divided into 1400 training, 331 validation, and 100 held‑out test images, with
all model development experiments conducted using only the training and validation sub‑
sets. We compared a conventional five‑class taxonomy with a task‑oriented binary scheme
and evaluated multiple YOLO26 model scales, architectural modifications, and two repre‑
sentative lightweight YOLO detectors. Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

Across the three independently trained runs corresponding to seeds
0, 42, and 123, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv achieved a mean held‑out test mAP@0.5 of
46.1 ± 1.8%, compared with 39.8 ± 4.7% for the YOLO26s baseline.

The method was
evaluated on OralXrays-9, comprising 12,688 panoramic radiographs and 84,099 retained
annotations across nine categories, using a fixed 2688-image hold-out cohort. Twenty-two
detector configurations were compared under a common protocol, and A0–A2 were further
assessed using three independent seeds and paired radiograph-level bootstrap analysis.

retrieval.question: 比较《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》和《Constructing a Xiangyunsha Defect Dataset and a Lightweight Detection Model for Sustainability》：两者的缺陷识别结果最终如何服务实际决策？请比较输电设备热/结构异常检测与香云纱人工设计干预，并说明落地效果的表述边界。
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：热感知融合综合可见光结构缺陷与红外热异常，融合图像交给统一YOLO检测器服务设备缺陷识别，实验支持检测表征改善。香云纱将传统缺陷视作设计资源，定位结果支持工匠和设计者定向印染及局部裁切，是人主导决策支持。香云纱的定量节材、外部泛化和生命周期收益仍待验证；检测成绩不能直接表述为已证明减废效益或自主质量控制效果，二者业务目标不同。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Infrared and visible images provide complementary information for transmission equip-
ment inspection, but a single modality is often insufficient to simultaneously represent
structural defects and thermal abnormalities.

When the
fused images are evaluated using a unified YOLO-based detector, the proposed thermal-
aware fusion framework achieves precision, recall, and mAP at IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936,
0.921, and 0.943, respectively. These results indicate that the proposed thermal-aware fusion
framework can effectively integrate visible structural information and infrared thermal
response information and improve the recognition of transmission equipment defects in
complex inspection scenarios.

Beyond detection, we
further conducted a descriptive design case study in which localized Xiangyunsha surface
irregularities informed human‑led design interventions, including targeted artistic print‑
ing/dyeing for textile_abnormal regions and localized pattern cutting for Stain_Patch re‑
gions. The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑
ity control system. This study demonstrates the feasibility of linking defect localization
with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

gold_evidence.evidence:
Infrared and visible images provide complementary information for transmission equip-
ment inspection, but a single modality is often insufficient to simultaneously represent
structural defects and thermal abnormalities.

When the
fused images are evaluated using a unified YOLO-based detector, the proposed thermal-
aware fusion framework achieves precision, recall, and mAP at IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936,
0.921, and 0.943, respectively. These results indicate that the proposed thermal-aware fusion
framework can effectively integrate visible structural information and infrared thermal
response information and improve the recognition of transmission equipment defects in
complex inspection scenarios.

Beyond detection, we
further conducted a descriptive design case study in which localized Xiangyunsha surface
irregularities informed human‑led design interventions, including targeted artistic print‑
ing/dyeing for textile_abnormal regions and localized pattern cutting for Stain_Patch re‑
gions. The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑
ity control system. This study demonstrates the feasibility of linking defect localization
with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：ResNet针对更深网络的训练退化和优化困难，通过残差学习和shortcut使深层表征可训练，表征用于分类、检测、分割。Vim针对自注意力长视觉序列的速度/内存压力，使用双向状态空间模型取得上下文，先以ImageNet监督分类训练，再作为骨干迁移到语义分割、目标检测、实例分割。二者都有可迁移表征，但主要瓶颈与机制不同；骨干不等同无需任务头的端到端分割系统。

retrieval.question: 比较《An Intelligent Framework for Tooth Segmentation and Classification Through Fusion of Transfer Learning with Advanced Optimization Algorithms Using Biomedical Images》和《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》：它们都采用特征融合，但融合的互补性来自哪里，融合后的分类/检测链条又有什么区别？
retrieval.reference_answer: 要点：牙齿框架在同一牙科X光的分割牙区上，以DenseNet201、MobileNet、ShuffleNetV2提取互补深度特征并融合，由BCO调参的KELM进行牙类分类，互补性来自不同特征提取模型。热感知方法从可见光与红外两种输入提取结构纹理和热响应，融合共享/模态特有信息并进行热感知门控，融合图像用于YOLO缺陷检测，互补性来自传感模态。多模型特征融合不能说成红外—可见光双模态融合。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The segmented tooth regions are then processed through DenseNet201, 
MobileNet, and ShuffleNetV2 to obtain complementary deep feature representations, 
which are fused to construct a comprehensive feature representation. The fused features 
are classified using a Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM), whose penalty parame-
ter 𝐶 and RBF kernel parameter 𝛾 are optimized using Bacterial Colony Optimization 
(BCO).

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》的核心架构、视觉建模问题和评测任务。
retrieval.reference_answer: 论文针对把Mamba用于视觉时的单向建模和位置感知不足，提出Vim：图像切patch并线性投影，加入位置嵌入，用双向选择性状态空间块进行依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模。先在ImageNet监督图像分类上训练，再将骨干用于语义分割、目标检测和实例分割。状态空间计算随序列长度线性增长，与全局自注意力的二次增长形成效率差异；论文报告的优势应限定在其任务、模型和实验设置内。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

We first
split the input image into patches and linearly project them
as vectors to Vim. Image patches are treated as the sequence
data in Vim blocks, which efficiently compresses the vi-
sual representation with the proposed bidirectional selective
state space.

In
the current stage, we train the Vim model on the supervised
image classification task using the ImageNet dataset and
then use the pretrained Vim as the backbone to perform
sequential visual representation learning for downstream
dense prediction tasks, i.e., semantic segmentation, object
detection, and instance segmentation.

where self-attention is quadratic to sequence length M, and
SSM is linear to sequence length M (N is a fixed parameter,
set to 16 by default).

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model》的核心架构、视觉建模问题和评测任务。
retrieval.reference_answer: 论文针对把Mamba用于视觉时的单向建模和位置感知不足，提出Vim：图像切patch并线性投影，加入位置嵌入，用双向选择性状态空间块进行依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模。先在ImageNet监督图像分类上训练，再将骨干用于语义分割、目标检测和实例分割。状态空间计算随序列长度线性增长，与全局自注意力的二次增长形成效率差异；论文报告的优势应限定在其任务、模型和实验设置内。

gold_evidence.evidence:
However, there are two challenges for Mamba, i.e., unidi-
rectional modeling and lack of positional awareness. To
address these challenges, we propose the Vision Mamba
(Vim) model, which incorporates the bidirectional SSMs for
data-dependent global visual context modeling and position
embeddings for location-aware visual recognition.

We first
split the input image into patches and linearly project them
as vectors to Vim. Image patches are treated as the sequence
data in Vim blocks, which efficiently compresses the vi-
sual representation with the proposed bidirectional selective
state space.

In
the current stage, we train the Vim model on the supervised
image classification task using the ImageNet dataset and
then use the pretrained Vim as the backbone to perform
sequential visual representation learning for downstream
dense prediction tasks, i.e., semantic segmentation, object
detection, and instance segmentation.

where self-attention is quadratic to sequence length M, and
SSM is linear to sequence length M (N is a fixed parameter,
set to 16 by default).

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》的统一视觉表示方法和训练流程。
retrieval.reference_answer: Video-LLaVA使用LanguageBind图像与视频编码器，使两种视觉表示在投影前对齐到共同的语言特征空间，再经共享投影层与文本token组合送入大语言模型。联合训练的单个batch同时含图像和视频样本；训练包括视觉理解训练和指令微调。前一阶段以自回归目标学习基本视觉理解并冻结其他参数；后一阶段要求响应更复杂的视觉理解指令，LLM也参与训练，最后按不同指令和请求生成回答。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

We dynami-
cally conduct joint training on images and videos,
wherein a single batch contains both image and
video samples simultaneously.

The training objective of this
stage is the original auto-regressive loss, where the
model learns the basic ability to view the vision.
We freeze the other parameters of the model during
this process.

In this stage, the model is required to provide
responses corresponding to different instructions.
These instructions often involve more complex
visual comprehension tasks, rather than just de-
scribing visual signals.

After this stage, the model learns to generate
corresponding responses based on different instruc-
tions and requests. The LLM are also involved in
training at this stage.

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《Video-LLaVA: Learning United Visual Representation by Alignment Before Projection》的统一视觉表示方法和训练流程。
retrieval.reference_answer: Video-LLaVA使用LanguageBind图像与视频编码器，使两种视觉表示在投影前对齐到共同的语言特征空间，再经共享投影层与文本token组合送入大语言模型。联合训练的单个batch同时含图像和视频样本；训练包括视觉理解训练和指令微调。前一阶段以自回归目标学习基本视觉理解并冻结其他参数；后一阶段要求响应更复杂的视觉理解指令，LLM也参与训练，最后按不同指令和请求生成回答。

Therefore, our
video encoder and image encoder are initialized
from the LanguageBind encoders zoo, pre-aligning
the inputs for LLM and reducing the gap between
representations of different visual signals. The uni-
fied visual representation is fed into LLM after
passing through a shared projection layer.

We dynami-
cally conduct joint training on images and videos,
wherein a single batch contains both image and
video samples simultaneously.

The training objective of this
stage is the original auto-regressive loss, where the
model learns the basic ability to view the vision.
We freeze the other parameters of the model during
this process.

In this stage, the model is required to provide
responses corresponding to different instructions.
These instructions often involve more complex
visual comprehension tasks, rather than just de-
scribing visual signals.

After this stage, the model learns to generate
corresponding responses based on different instruc-
tions and requests. The LLM are also involved in
training at this stage.

retrieval.question: 请总结论文《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》推荐的评测配置、数据集使用方式和不推荐的做法。
retrieval.reference_answer: 论文研究如何兼顾排名代表性与训练效率。推荐使用ViT-B、16×16 patch、线性解码器进行端到端微调；这组配置相对于更大模型、更强解码器和更小patch的配置，能够大幅减少训练时间并具有一定排名代表性。建议使用多个数据集进行训练和评估，因为数据集和域偏移会改变模型排名。论文不推荐仅做线性探测，因为冻结编码器得到的排名不能代表端到端微调。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Based on the results, the recommendation is to fine-
tune the ViT-B variants of VFMs with a 16 × 16 patch size
and a linear decoder, as these settings are representative of
using a larger model, more advanced decoder and smaller
patch size, while reducing training time by more than 13
times.

Leveraging multiple datasets for train-
ing and evaluation is also recommended, as the performance
ranking across datasets and domain shifts varies. Linear
probing is not recommended, as it is not representative of
end-to-end fine-tuning.

This study developed the TSCFFM-AOABI model to provide an automated approach
for tooth instance segmentation and tooth-level classification in dental X-ray images, with
potential use as a supplementary tool for dental image analysis. The proposed framework
involves Blur, MedianBlur, ToGray, and CLAHE for preprocessing, followed by fusion-

TSCFFM-AOABI method was validated through comprehensive studies using a bench-
mark image dataset. The performance validation of the TSCFFM-AOABI method demon-
strated an accuracy of 96.17% compared with the evaluated existing techniques.

gold_evidence.evidence:
The vision subsystem combines deep-learning-based
object detection with stereo vision to estimate traffic cone positions relative to the camera
coordinate system.

For this the cone collector program collects 50 consecutive measurements and calcu-
lates their average. The experiment results showed that this number is a balance between
fast execution and high accuracy.

The combination of point averaging and multi-stage observation provides sufficient
positioning accuracy for reliable cone grasping.

The system utilizes the collaborative features
of the robot arm by measuring the load applied to the end-effector before and after the
grasping operation, allowing automatic validation of a successful cone grasp.

YOLO11-OBB is used to provide rotation-aware localization for inference in this study.

AISGAN amodal reconstruction and improve robustness under arbitrary fruit orientation.

used to enhance robustness under asymmetric occlusion by capturing alternative boundary
interpretations and reducing underestimation. Figure 5c shows this process, where two
ellipses are generated from different minor-axis points and merged to form the final
reconstructed shape.

The vision subsystem combines deep-learning-based
object detection with stereo vision to estimate traffic cone positions relative to the camera
coordinate system.

For this the cone collector program collects 50 consecutive measurements and calcu-
lates their average. The experiment results showed that this number is a balance between
fast execution and high accuracy.

The combination of point averaging and multi-stage observation provides sufficient
positioning accuracy for reliable cone grasping.

The system utilizes the collaborative features
of the robot arm by measuring the load applied to the end-effector before and after the
grasping operation, allowing automatic validation of a successful cone grasp.

YOLO11-OBB is used to provide rotation-aware localization for inference in this study.
The oriented bounding boxes are converted into ellipse-based geometric priors that guide
AISGAN amodal reconstruction and improve robustness under arbitrary fruit orientation.

This dual-ellipse strategy is
used to enhance robustness under asymmetric occlusion by capturing alternative boundary
interpretations and reducing underestimation. Figure 5c shows this process, where two
ellipses are generated from different minor-axis points and merged to form the final
reconstructed shape.

The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

Experiments are conducted on a spatially aligned infrared–visible dataset
containing normal insulator strings, normal strain clamps, damaged insulator strings,
insulator thermal faults, and strain clamp thermal faults.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

Based exclusively on the validation results across

The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑

with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

retrieval.reference_answer: 输电设备论文使用配准的可见光与红外图像，采用双流结构、共享/专属特征交互与热感知门控融合，得到融合表示并供YOLO检测结构和热异常。排水监控论文输入固定监控摄像头图像，以SAM 3及water文本提示进行零样本分割，提取水面积比例与归一化水线，结合规则进行降雨/积水事件与误报分析。香云纱论文构建1831张缺陷图像的数据集，验证集选择YOLO26s-DWR + DynamicConv，用缺陷位置支持人工设计干预；其流程是设计决策支持，量化减废和生命周期收益仍待验证。

gold_evidence.evidence:
The method employs separate visible and infrared branches to
extract structural texture features and thermal response features, respectively. A shared–
specific feature representation and interaction mechanism is then introduced to model
visible-specific, infrared-specific, and cross-modal shared information, thereby improving
complementary feature integration between the two modalities. In addition, a thermal-
aware gated enhancement module adaptively strengthens salient thermal responses while
preserving visible structural details.

Experiments are conducted on a spatially aligned infrared–visible dataset
containing normal insulator strings, normal strain clamps, damaged insulator strings,
insulator thermal faults, and strain clamp thermal faults.

Using SAM 3 with the text prompt “water”, we extract per‑frame
water‑area ratio and normalized waterline level, and evaluate (i) quadrant‑wise segmenta‑
tion stability, (ii) rain‑event detection, (iii) false‑alarm behavior on negative days, and (iv)
pixel‑level agreement with expert reference masks.

we constructed a specialized Xiangyunsha defect‑image
dataset comprising 1831 annotated images.

Based exclusively on the validation results across
three predefined random seeds, YOLO26s‑DWR + DynamicConv was selected as the final
modified architecture.

The resulting detection–interpretation–design intervention workflow positions AI
as a decision support tool for artisans and designers rather than as an autonomous qual‑
ity control system. This study demonstrates the feasibility of linking defect localization
with human‑led material‑retention strategies, while quantitative waste reduction, external
generalizability, and lifecycle benefits remain to be established in future studies.

retrieval.question: 根据《An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale》，为什么不能仅根据ImageNet上从头训练的表现否定ViT？请结合归纳偏置和预训练规模的实验讨论。
retrieval.reference_answer: ViT缺少CNN的局部性和平移等变性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化会受到影响；这说明小数据训练结果依赖数据规模，不能直接否定该架构。论文在更大预训练集上看到更强结果：ViT-Large在ImageNet预训练下不如ViT-Base，ImageNet-21k下相近，JFT-300M下才显现大模型的完整收益。该结论限定于论文的模型与实验，不能推成任意数据规模下ViT都优于CNN。

gold_evidence.evidence:
inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well
when trained on insufﬁcient amounts of data.
However, the picture changes if the models are trained on larger datasets (14M-300M images). We
ﬁnd that large scale training trumps inductive bias.

When pre-trained on the
smallest dataset, ImageNet, ViT-Large models underperform compared to ViT-Base models, despite
(moderate) regularization. With ImageNet-21k pre-training, their performances are similar. Only
with JFT-300M, do we see the full beneﬁt of larger models.

retrieval.reference_answer: 论文将原始Mamba用于视觉的困难概括为单向建模和缺乏位置感知。双向SSM用于依赖数据的全局视觉上下文建模；位置嵌入为视觉识别提供位置信息，在密集预测中体现空间感知。它们是不同问题的对应设计，不能把双向性理解为代替位置信息。

retrieval.question: 根据《How to Benchmark Vision Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation?》，为什么线性探测更省训练资源却仍不被推荐作为端到端微调的替代评测？
retrieval.reference_answer: 冻结编码器会改变不同VFM的表现与排名，论文得到的排名相关系数仅0.38。因此线性探测虽然减少训练成本，却不足以代表端到端微调的结果；作者建议使用端到端微调来获得有代表性的比较。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Current VFMs
may not acquire enough spatial semantic understanding in
pretraining to perform semantic segmentation effectively
without end-to-end fine-tuning. Furthermore, a low correla-
tion coefficient of 0.38 suggests freezing the encoder signif-
icantly changes the performance ranking. Therefore, even
though linear probing is efficient, end-to-end fine-tuning is
recommended for a representative benchmark.

[10], constructed fast semantic maps from visual sequences [11], reviewed semantic map-
ping for mobile robots [12], and combined lightweight image segmentation with 3D se-
mantic mapping in unstructured lawn scenes [13]. Direct semantic segmentation of 3D
point clouds provides another route for adding category information to reconstructed ge-
ometry, particularly in construction applications [14]. These studies, together with Seman-
ticFusion and more recent 2D-guided 3D instance and scene-representation methods [15–
17], establish that semantics and geometry can be spatially associated in a common 3D
representation. Accordingly, the research gap for post-disaster flexible suction is not the
generic combination of 2D semantics and 3D geometry, but how to connect lightweight
obstacle masks, metrically reconstructed sludge geometry, supporting camera-position
information, and explicit suction constraints within one processing framework.

Appl. Sci. 2026, 16, 10003 2 of 26
spatial consistency may lead to collision, inefficient suction, pose disturbance, or second-
ary instability. For this task, image-level recognition alone is insufficient: the perception
output must preserve obstacle identity while providing metric scene geometry and spatial
information that can be used to determine a suction-point reference.
Pixel- and instance-level segmentation provides detailed obstacle semantics, but im-
age-plane categories, boxes, and masks do not directly provide the metric quantities re-
quired for manipulation. Deep-learning-based disaster recognition and debris-flow detec-
tion have demonstrated the value of image semantics for extracting hazard-related infor-
mation from complex scenes [3,5], while lightweight segmentation is especially relevant
when visual processing must share limited computation with subsequent geometric pro-
cessing. However, a 2D mask does not by itself provide physical height, surface slope,

sludge-deposit thickness, or obstacle clearance. Projection-based work in unstructured
construction environments has shown that image-derived semantics can be transferred to
3D point clouds to support spatial interpretation [6]. This motivates connecting reliable
image-level obstacle segmentation with a metric 3D representation rather than treating
the segmentation output as the final perception result.
The integration of semantic information with 3D geometry has already been explored
in several application domains. Eye-in-hand semantic reconstruction has combined ma-
nipulator-mounted visual acquisition with semantic 3D modeling [7]. Semantic multi-
view stereo methods have fused 2D segmentation with multi-view geometry to generate
semantic point clouds [8], and semantically aware multi-view reconstruction has incorpo-
rated semantic consistency into sparse and dense reconstruction for complex urban scenes
[9]. Other Applied Sciences studies have transferred deep image segmentation to 3D maps

Appl. Sci. 2026, 16, 10003 4 of 26
outputs rather than as a standalone high-precision localization solution. The metric trans-
formation enables the reconstructed sludge geometry to be evaluated and interpreted
through physical quantities rather than only through scale-ambiguous scene structure.
(3) A projection-based 2D-to-3D semantic label transfer procedure transfers Stone
and Shrub labels from the YOLO-LiteSeg 2D instance masks to the corresponding recon-
structed 3D points. The resulting obstacle-highlighted metric 3D point cloud is then used
for constraint-based suction-point selection under the predefined suction-depth and max-
imin obstacle-clearance criteria, yielding a selected suction-point reference rather than a
global optimum for the complete suction trajectory or process.
The remaining sections present the proposed perception framework, experimental
protocol, results and discussion under nine controlled simulated working conditions and
an additional dual-peak scene, followed by the conclusions.

retrieval.reference_answer: 冻结编码器会改变不同VFM的表现与排名，论文得到的排名相关系数仅0.38。因此线性探测虽然减少训练成本，却不足以代表端到端微调的结果；作者建议使用端到端微调来获得有代表性的比较。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Current VFMs
may not acquire enough spatial semantic understanding in
pretraining to perform semantic segmentation effectively
without end-to-end fine-tuning. Furthermore, a low correla-
tion coefficient of 0.38 suggests freezing the encoder signif-
icantly changes the performance ranking. Therefore, even
though linear probing is efficient, end-to-end fine-tuning is
recommended for a representative benchmark.

retrieval.question: 根据《SBRF-Det: Scale-Boundary Representative Fusion for Multi-Finding Detection in Panoramic Dental Radiographs》，为什么边界相关局部信息对mAP50-95比仅正确分类更关键？请结合正文中的局部与全局融合解释。
retrieval.reference_answer: mAP50-95要求在逐渐严格的IoU阈值下仍有准确边界框重叠，正确类别本身不足以获得较高指标。局部信息保留病灶边缘、修复体界面、牙根等结构线索，可以影响框几何；全局上下文帮助区分外观相似而解剖位置不同的发现。边界门控对局部分支增强调节更强、对全局分支仅适度衰减，以兼顾边界定位与语义上下文。

gold_evidence.evidence:
A strong boundary response increases
the local contribution while only moderately attenuating the global branch.

Global context
helps distinguish visually similar structures that occur in different anatomical settings,
while local evidence is retained around lesion margins, restoration interfaces, root struc-
tures, and other high-frequency regions. The P4 placement further preserves a spatial
resolution at which these cues can influence box geometry. This design is particularly
relevant to mAP50-95, where correct class prediction alone is insufficient and bounding-box
overlap must remain accurate across progressively stricter IoU thresholds.

Early dental deep-learning studies usually treated panoramic interpretation as a
narrowly defined detection or segmentation problem. This task-centered design made

whatcouldbeinferredaboutperformancewhenseveralunrelatedfindingscoexistinthe

retrieval.reference_answer: mAP50-95要求在逐渐严格的IoU阈值下仍有准确边界框重叠，正确类别本身不足以获得较高指标。局部信息保留病灶边缘、修复体界面、牙根等结构线索，可以影响框几何；全局上下文帮助区分外观相似而解剖位置不同的发现。边界门控对局部分支增强调节更强、对全局分支仅适度衰减，以兼顾边界定位与语义上下文。

retrieval.question: 根据《A Thermal-Aware Infrared–Visible Image Fusion Method for Defect Detection in Power Transmission Equipment》，为什么可见光与红外需要互补融合，而简单平均仍有局限？
retrieval.reference_answer: 可见光提供轮廓、纹理与结构异常，但受光照、背景和遮挡影响；红外能揭示异常发热，却缺少丰富纹理且结构边界模糊。简单平均能加入两种信息，但平等对待所有模态和位置，不考虑模态特性、空间重要性与热响应分布。论文因此采用热感知门控和共享/专属特征交互；在该文同协议检测对比中，提出方法的mAP@0.5:0.95为0.657，简单平均为0.597，不能把该结果外推到所有融合任务。

gold_evidence.evidence:
Visible images provide rich appear-
ance, contour, and texture information and are therefore suitable for identifying structural
abnormalities such as damage, cracks, deformation, and foreign object attachment. Infrared
images provide complementary thermal response information and are particularly use-
ful for revealing abnormal heating associated with poor contact, insulation degradation,
and other thermally related faults. However, visible images are sensitive to illumination,
background interference, and occlusion, whereas infrared images generally provide limited
texture details and relatively blurred structural boundaries [4].

However, simple averaging treats visible and infrared information equally and does
not consider modality-specific characteristics, spatial importance, or thermal response
distribution. The proposed fused representation achieves precision, recall, and mAP at
IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936, 0.921, and 0.943, respectively. Compared with simple average
fusion, the proposed framework improves mAP at IoU = 0.5:0.95 from 0.597 to 0.657,
corresponding to an absolute improvement of 0.060.

ance, contour, and texture information and are therefore suitable for identifying structural
abnormalities such as damage, cracks, deformation, and foreign object attachment. Infrared
images provide complementary thermal response information and are particularly use-
ful for revealing abnormal heating associated with poor contact, insulation degradation,
and other thermally related faults. However, visible images are sensitive to illumination,
background interference, and occlusion, whereas infrared images generally provide limited
texture details and relatively blurred structural boundaries [4].

However, simple averaging treats visible and infrared information equally and does
not consider modality-specific characteristics, spatial importance, or thermal response
distribution. The proposed fused representation achieves precision, recall, and mAP at
IoU = 0.5 values of 0.936, 0.921, and 0.943, respectively. Compared with simple average
fusion, the proposed framework improves mAP at IoU = 0.5:0.95 from 0.597 to 0.657,
corresponding to an absolute improvement of 0.060.

retrieval.reference_answer: 规则与阈值来自同一批负例数据，因此0/102是回顾性、样本内的一致性结果，缺少独立前瞻验证。随后作者冻结SAM 3、water提示、0.25置信度和报警规则，在未参与阈值或规则设计的额外14天1072帧上不再调参运行。文中观察到的六个前瞻误报都是单帧模式切换瞬态，两帧持续条件是在观察这些失败后提出的后验加固，不能与原冻结规则的独立验证混为一谈。

Both rules and the threshold were designed from the
negative‑day data reported in Section 5.3, to which the 4 September day belongs; the
alarm evaluation there is therefore retrospective and in‑sample, and its zero‑alarm out‑
come should be read as a consistency demonstration rather than an independent prospec‑
tive validation.

selected 14 additional days at the reference
site that had never been used for threshold or rule design: seven days with event‑triggered
5‑min capture (11/12/13/14 August 2026, 31 August, 1 September, 17 September) and seven
routine hourly capture days (24/25/27 August 2026, 8/10/13/15 September), totaling 1072
frames. The pipeline (SAM 3, prompt “water”, confidence 0.25) and both alarm rules were

retrieval.question: 根据《Multi-View Semantic–Geometric Perception for Post-Disaster Flexible Suction with Metric 3D Scene Reconstruction》，为什么仅有2D实例掩码或未对齐物理尺度的3D重建不足以支持吸取点选择？
retrieval.reference_answer: 2D掩码提供障碍物语义，但不能直接给出物理高度、坡度或障碍物间距。吸取深度、沉积厚度、距离等是有单位的量，未定尺度的重建不能直接应用这些约束。论文将YOLO-LiteSeg语义与VGGT几何结合，用棋盘格对齐到物理尺度并将2D标签转到3D点云，在吸取深度和最大化最小障碍物间距准则下生成参考点。

cannot provide physical height, surface slope, or obstacle clearance, while geometry with-

tionally be converted to physical scale because sludge-deposit thickness, height proﬁles, 
obstacle distances, and suction depth are metric quantities rather than scale-ambiguous 
geometric descriptors.

and reconstructed geometry is converted into a suction-point reference using the target 
suction-depth  criterion  and  the  maximin  obstacle-clearance  criterion.
